GIBBINGS, ALBERT VICTOR, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Mar., 1913; Kedah, Apr., 1913; ag. exec. engrnr., Kedah, Jan., 1917; exec. engrnr., Johore, Sept., 1925; ag. senr. exec. engrnr., F.M.S., Apr., 1927; senr. exec. engrnr., F.M.S., Jan., 1929; water wks. engrnr., Semban, June, 1930; senr. exec. engrnr., Klang, Apr., 1931; ag. state engrnr., Pahang, June, 1931; senr. exec. engrnr., Coast, Kuantan, Jan., 1932.

GIBBON, GEOFFREY MCKAY, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.)—B. 1896; ed. Elgin acad., Gordon Coll., Aberdeen and Univ. of Edin.; dist. med. offr., Cyprus, Oct., 1933.

GIBBON, JOHN FRANK, M.B., C.M. (Edin.)—B. 1889; entd. med. serv., Trinidad, Jan., 1899; dist. med. offr., Jan., 1916.

GIBBS, GEORGE HOWARD.—B. 1889; asst. dist. commnr., Gold Coast, Aug., 1920.

GIBSON, CLARENCE HYN.—B. 1876; ag. dist. offr., Gilbert and Ellice Is., Jan., 1914; confirmed in apptntn., Jan., 1916; a dep. commnr. for the W. Pacific, with powers in Gilbert group, June, 1915.

GIBSON, H. D.—B. 1886; ed. Bedale and Lincoln Gram. Schls.; junr. traffic asst., Nigerian rly., 1910; asst. traffic supt., 1913; dist. ditto, 1920; traffic supt., 1922; divnl. supt., 1927; supt. of line, 1932.

GIBSON, LESLIE BERTRAM.—B. 1896; ed. King Henry VIII. Schi., Coventry; hon. LL.B. (War), London; flight sub-lieut., R.N.A.S., attds. Grand Fleet; lieut. R.A.F.; cadet, S.S., Mar., 1920; attd. atty-gen.'s office, S'pore, Apr., 1920; attd. food control office, Penang, May, 1920; dep. dir. food prodn., Apr., 1921; passed cadet, Mar., 1922; dep. regar. and asst. off. assignee, Penang, June, 1922; offr., cls. V., Mar., 1923; asst. sec. to res., Selangor, July, 1925; asst. regar., sup. ct., Ipoh, Mar., 1927; offr., cls. IV., Mar., 1927; ag. dep. pub. pros., Penang, Dec., 1930; offr., cls. III., Mar., 1932; ag. legal advr., Kedah, Aug., 1932.

GIBSON, ROY ALEXANDER.—B. 1885; ed. Brandon High Schi. and Brandon Coll.; ent. fed. govt. serv. at Regina, 1908; transfd. to Ottawa, and apptd. ch. clk. to dep. min., 1908; asst. dep. min., June, 1919; oomsnr., Yukon and N.W. Territories, 1923.

GIBSON, WILLIAM SUMNER, C.M.G. (1834), R.A., Oxon., Barrister-at-Law (Lincoln's Inn);—B. 1876; ed. Marlborough and Keble Coll., Oxford (schol.), B.A. (1st clas. med. hist.), 1899; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1899; services lent to Johore govt., July-Nov., 1908; asst. man., monopolies dept., Penang, Oct., 1909; called to the bar, June, 1913; legal adviser, Kedah, Jan., 1916; offr., cls. III., Mar., 1916; judge of high. cd., Kedah (in addn.), July, 1916; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; pres., comm. to inquire into organisation and expend. of govt. dep'ts., F.M.S., Feb., 1922; offr., cls. I.A., Dec., 1922; legal advr., F.M.S., Dec., 1922; pres., S.S. trade comm., Mar., 1933.

GIE, S. F. N., Ph.D.—B. 1886; ed. Van Coll., Stellenbosch and Amsterdam; lect. Univ.; teacher and inspr. schls., Cape Prov., hist. and chmn., senate, Stellenbosch; 1918; under-secr., educn., Union of S. Africa, 1926; sec., ditto, 1927; publications include new of S. Africa in Afrikaans in two vols.

GILBERT, HUMPHREY RALEIGH.—B. 1895; ent. R. Navy, 1912; served, Great War; ret., Jan., 1923; lieut. commodr. (ret'd), Feb.; admtn. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Jan.; asst. dist. offr., Jan., 1929; ag. dist. offr., N.

GILBERT, JOSEPH TROUSSELL, O.B.E., B.A. (Oxon.)—B. 1888; ed. Bedford and Exm Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Lincolns Inn, 1914; asst. collr. (now asst. dist. commnr.), Zibar, Jan., 1912; ag. mag., Mar. to Jun., 1912; 2nd asst. sec., and priv. sec. to res., Jun.; off. examr. in the Swahili language, senr. ast. sec., Sept., 1924; asst. ch. sec., 1928; del., C.O. confcn., 1930; ag. ch. sec. various periods between 1924 and 1928; (for the Brilliant Star of Zanzibar, cls. IV., 1928-III., 1930.

GILCHRIST, WILLIAM JAMES.—B. 1879; entd. H.M. Customs, B. Guiana, Dec.; copyist, regar.'s office, Oct., 1900; dist. ditto, Mar., 1902; 5th cls. clk., cust., 1904; commissary, Sept., 1905; clk. to stty. gr., 1906; stip. mag., J.T., coroner, and comm. oaths, 1910; chmn., Rose Hall village council of lands comm., 1911; called to the bar, Inn, 1914; ag. asst. govt. sec., Mar., 1914; censor (war) under defence scheme, 1914; censor (war) under defence scheme, 20; recd. thanks of S. of S.; practised at Edinbar, 1920-21; commr. to inquire into distur. H.M. penal stattn., B. Guiana, 1923; ag. puimse judge, in 1923 and 1925-6; ag. puimse judge, in 1923, 1924 and 1925-6; ag. puimse judge, in 1926 and 1927; puimse judge, Sept., 1927; puimse judge, Trinidad, 1931.

GILKS, J. L., C.M.G. (1933), M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Edin.)—ag. offr., E.A.P., Aug., 1909; prin. med. offr., Feb., 1921; mem., exec. and leg. comm., med. and sany. services, 1926.

GILL, EDWIN—B. 1896; on naval serv., 1919; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., 12th July, 1926.

GILL, EDWIN LEONARD, D.Sc.—B. 1877; Manchester Museum, June, 1904; curat. cock Museum, Newcastle-on-Tyne, Jul., 1927; asst. R. Scottish Museum, July, 1927; African Museum, Cape Town, Jan., 1928.

GILL, HENRY SEWELL CUMBER, M.A.—1903; cadet, provincial adminstr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1927; asst. dist. offr., Aug.

GILL, OSCAR SAYLE.—B. 1880; engnr., elec. dept., Ceylon, Nov., 1927; engrnr. and man., elec. undertakings, June.

GILL, RONALD GODDARD.—B. 1886; Haberdashers' Askes Schi. (Hampstead); serv. overseas, 1917-19; commissioned, 1917; temp. clk., Miny. of Lab., 1919; after compet. exam., cler. offr., O.C.O. Mr.

GILLMAN, CLEMENT, F.G.S., M.S.A., F.R.G.S.—B. 1882; ed. Swiss Federal schl., Zurich; on rly. constr. and surve., Africa, 1906-14; served E.A.P. Force, b. capt., rly. corps.; exec. engrnr., E. Afric. rlys. (occupied territory), 1916-18; dist. ditto, 1918-19; dist. engrnr., Tanganyi
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

1919; senr. dist. engnr., Apr., 1925; ch. r., Apr., 1928.

LMOUR, ANDREW.—B. 1898; ed. Royal Schl., Edin. and Edin. Univ.; served with A. & S.H., B.E.F., 1916-17; M.A. hons., 1920; cadet, S.S., Apr., 1921; attch. to councillors' office, Penang, May, 1921; offr., astt. contrlr., lab., Penang and astt. prot., Kedah, Apr., 1924; astt. contrlr., lab., cem., Feb., 1926; collr., land rev., S'pore, 1927; astt. astt., govt. monops., S'pore, 1927; offr., cls. IV, Apr., 1928; res., Jan., June, 1928; dist. offr., Jasir, Sept., ditto, U. Kelantan, Dec., 1930; offr., cls., Apr., 1933.

MSON, FRANKLIN CHARLES.—B. 1890; B.A., cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1914; attd. to col. sec's office, Dec., 1914; attd. of naval intell. offr., in add. to his duties; addtl. pol. mag., Colombo, in add. to his own duties; on mil. duty, 1918; astt. pol. astt. col. sec., July, 1919; office astt. to agt., N. C. Prov., Sept., 1919; addnl. astt., cem., Mar., 1920; 4th astt. ditto, Sept., 1920; astt. govt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1922; landing offr., cust., Feb., 1924; ag. dep. collr., cust., Mar., May, 1928; addnl. astt. dir. educn., Mar., sec. to min. educn., July, 1931; astt. agt., Trincomalee, Feb., 1932.

MEN, JAMES ALEXANDER, M.A.—Ed. Trinity, Dublin; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Dec., 1917; lieut., July, 1917; ag. capt., Nov., 1918; served in France and Palestine; demob., Jan., 1919; astt. dir. of edn., Iraq, Apr., 1920; ag. min. of educn., Apr., 1922.

MENDAY, VINCENT G., O.B.E. (1929), M.A., F.R.S., Diploma, Forestry, Edin. (hons. nat. sci.), F.G.S., Diploma, Forestry, dist. commr., E.A.P., Dec., 1913; ag. commr., N. Frontier, Jan., 1914 to June, 1919; offr. in charge, Somali disarmament, N. Frontier dist., Mar., 1919 (A.G.S. Med.); served as dist. commr., Br. Somaliland, Mar.-Dec., 1920; astt. dist. commr., Oct., 1922; ag. commr., Sept., 1922; dist. commr., 1926; mission in Somalia, 1927-28; ag. prov. commr., 1931 and from Mar., 1933.

LENDINGHAM, JAMES, B.Sc. (Lond.), I.C.E.—B. 1888; ed. Queen's Univ., Belfast; dir., surveys, Gold Coast, Oct., 1919; dep. cadastral branch, Jan., 1920; dir., cadastral sch., Dec., 1920; dep. survr.-gen., Apr., 1924; survr.-gen. on various occasions, 1921-26; survr.-gen., Oct., 1926.

ODDBOLT, S. B.—B. 1884; clk., treasy., Cape Town, Transvaal, 1905; Union of S. Africa, 1910; clk., treasy., Union of S. Africa, 1920; ch. grade II, 1924; ditto, grade I, 1928; commr., July, 1932.

ODDARD, HARRY FREDERICK.—B. 1902; cad. after compet. exam., cler. off., C.O., 4th Oct., 1920.

ODDARD, THOMAS NELSON, M.B.E. (1918).—B. 1889; ed. Wadham Coll., Oxford; B.A.; priv. sec. to gov., Falkland Is. and clk. of leg. couns., Apr., 1914; lieut., Falkland Is. vol. force, Aug., 1914; capt., 1917; O.C.; postal censor, 1914; proper offr. of the n., prte., 1914; chief clk., col. sec's office, 1915; ag. commr. of currency, 1918; ag. audr., 1920; astt. col. sec., Sierra Leone; clk., exec. coun., 1921; A.D.C. to ag. gov., and to gov., 1922-23; census offr., 1921; astt. astt. col. sec. for various periods between 1922 and 1930; ag. col. sec. for various periods 1922-33; ch. astt. col. sec., Sept., 1930; gov.'s dep. on various occasions, 1930 and 1931; compiler, Sierra Leone, Handbook 1924.

GODDEN, HENRY JAMES, M.B.E. (1929)—B. 1877; telegraphist, Basutoland, 1902; postmr., 1907; clk. to astt. commr., 1917; ag. astt. commr., 1922; passed 1st grade Sesuto, 1922; ch. clk., mast. of ct. and regiar., 1924.

GODFREY, GEORGE CROSBIE.—B. 1880; ed. Waimataiata Schl., Timaru, N.Z.; N.Z. printing and stationery dept., 1897; priv. sec. to min. of pub. wks., 1901; astt. ch. clk., pub. wks. dept., 1908; ch. clk., 1914; astt. under-secr., 1920; sec. marine, 1923; sec. of lab. and commr. of employment, 1932.

GODFREY, SIR JOSEPH ED., KT. BACH. (1914).—B. 1856; M.B. and C.M., Edin., 1882; gov. med. offr., B. Guiana, Feb., 1883; med. inspr. of estates hospitals, May, 1898; deputy regiar. of births, deaths and marriages, 1898; deputy chmn., cent. bd. of health, 1902; astt. on sew. occasions as surg.-gen., regiar.-gen., and chmn. of cent. bd. of health; apptd. surg.-gen., regiar.-gen. of h. d. and m., chmn. cent. bd. of health, and offl. mem. of ct. of policy, and comb. ct., July, 1904; dep. chmn. of bd. of agric., 1905; chmn. of poor law commn., 1906; del. for B. Guiana and Bahamas to Internat. Leproay Confec., Bergen, 1909.

GODLEY, LIEUT.-GEN. SIR ALEXANDER JOHN, K.C.B., K.C.M.G.—B. 1867; lieut., Royal Dublin Fusiliers, 1886; adjutant, 1889; capt., 1896; major, 1897; colonel, 1906; apptd. comdt. New Zealand Forces, 1910, with local rank of major-general; comdg. New Zealand expeditionary force in Egypt and at Dardanelles, 1914-15; gazetted major-general, 1915; temp. lieut.-gen. in command of an Anzac army corps, France, 1916; lieut.-gen., 1918; gov. and comdr. in ch., Gibraltar, 1928; foreign decorations: Legion of Honour, Croix de Commandeur (1917); Order of the Crown, Grand Officier (Belgian) 1917; Order of the White Eagle (Serbian), 1917; Ordre de Guerre (Belgian), 1918.

GODSALL, WALTER DOUGLAS, B.A. (Oxon.).—Cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1923; attd. N'Eliya kach., Jan., 1924; ditto, Badulla kach., Aug., 1924; ditto, Kegalla kach., Mar., 1926; office astt., Ratnapura kach., Dec., 1928; ditto, Galle kach., Mar., 1929; ag. astt. govt. agt., Kandy, Jan., 1930.

GODWIN-AUSTEN, ROBERT ANNESLEY, F.R.G.S.—B. 1885; ed. St. Lawrence Coll., Ramsgate; employed on rly. and land surveys, Canada, 1910-14; served with line and field survey units, France, 1915-19; ment. in despatches; rly. survey, Persia, 1920-21; astt. survr., N. Rhodesia, 1929; dir. roads, 1927; dep. dir., surveys, Tangaika, 1929; dir., land registn. and surveys, Cyprus, Sept., 1933.

GOLDBURG, JOSEPH.—B. 1886; entd. crown agents' office, 1902; astt. head, gen. dept., 1919; astt. head, finance dept., 1922; astt. head, shipping dept., 1925; astt. head, finance dept., 1930; dep. head, finance dept., May, 1933; acotnt., W. African Currency bd., 1912-33.

GOLLAN, SIR HENRY COWPER, KT. BACH. (1921), C.B.E. (1918).—B. 1868; ed. at Charterhouse; M.A., Edin. (1887); called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Jan., 1891, N. circuit; priv. sec. to Col. Lugard, commr. and comdt., W.A.F.F., Sept. 1st, 1899; priv. sec. to H.C. of Nor. Nig., Jan.-Sept., 1900; ag. sec. to the admistr., June-Aug., 1900; atty.-gen. of Nor. Nig., Sept., 1900; ag. ch. just., Nov., 1900-Apr., 1901; ch. just., Nov., 1901; prepared criminal code for N. Nigeria, 1904; compiled proc. of N.
Nigeria, 1905; ch. just., Bermuda, 1904; prepared Cts. Consolidating Act, Bermuda, Dec., 1906; chmn. of produce comm., 1905 and of aliens comm., 1906; chmn. of bd. of educ., Bermuda, July, 1907; atty.-gen., Trinidad, 1911; atty.-gen., Ceylon, 1918; ch. just., Hong Kong, 1924; chmn., salaries comm., 1928-29; ret., Aug., 1930.

GONTIER, GEORGE, C.A., L.I.A.—B. 1869; ed. Commissioner's Sch., Montreal and priv. tuition; audr.-gen., Dominion of Canada, Jan., 1924.

GOOCH, STANLEY JOHN WILLIAM, A.M.I.C.E., chtd. civ. engrn.—B. 1889; asst. engrn., P.W.D., F.M.S., June, 1912; exec. engrn., Johore, May, 1922; sr. exec. engrn., P.W.D., June, 1927; sr. exec. engrn., hydraulics, Selangor, Mar., 1929; ag. state engrn., Selangor, Jan., 1930.

GOOD, CRICL ALBERT.—B. 1892; called to bar, 1913; served in Army, lieut. and capt., 1915-20; pol. mag., Gold Coast, 1921.

GOODALL, EDWARD BASIL HERBERT, C.B.E. (1934), M.B.E. (1918).—B. 1886; ed. Loughborough Grammar Sch., and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; B.A.; asst. nat. coms., N. Rhodesia, Mar., 1909; nat. coms., Sept., 1911; asst. mag., Nov., 1921; ag. dist. coms., Apr., 1928; dist. oomsh., Feb., 1929; prov. coms., Apr., 1929; ag. sec., nat. affrs., Sept.-Oct., 1931; mem., leg. coun.

GOODMAN, ARTHUR MITCHELL.—B. 1886; ed. New Coll., Oxon.; B.A. 1908; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1909; supernumerary mag., Ipoh, June, 1915; pres., rent assessment bd. for Penang, July, 1918; offr., cls. IV., F.M.S., Jan., 1919; supernum. offr., cls. III., Nov., 1921; offr., cls. II; ag. sec. for Chinese affrs., S.S., Nov., 1926; sec., ditto, Jan., 1927; offr., cls. IA, mem., exec. coun., S.S., July, 1931; res. conn., Penang, Apr., 1933.

GOODMAN, REGINALD ERNEST.—B. 1886; olk., Beaufortland, 1913; acmtg. olk., 1916; fin. sec., mast. and reglar., deeds, Bechuana land Prot., Oct., 1927.

GOODWIN, LIEUT.-GEN. SIR THOMAS HERBERT JOHN CHAPMAN, K.C.B. (1919), K.C.M.G. (1932), C.B. (1918), C.M.G. (1915), D.S.O. (1898), hon. D.Sc. (Oxon.), F.R.C.S. (Eng.).—B. 1871; ed. Newton Coll., Devon and St. Mary's Hosp., London; comsdr., Army Med. Serv., 1893; staff surg., Mohmand Field Force, N.W. Frontier, 1897 (desps., med. and clasps); European War, 1914-18 (3 times ment. in desps., Mona Star, 1914, Allied and Victory meda.); A.D.M.S. with Mr. Balfour's mission to U.S.A., 1917; dir.-gen., Army Med. GOONETILLEKE, OLIVER ERNEST, B.A. (Lond.)—B. 1892; asst. audr., rly., Ceylon, Aug., 1921; asst. col. audr., Feb. to Dee., 1923; asst. col. audr., Feb., 1925; ag. col. audr., Feb. to Aug., 1927; audr.-gen., July, 1931.

GOPSIILL, WALTER LEONARD, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—Ed. Alleyne's Sch., Dulwich, King's Coll. and St. Thomas's Hosp.; R.F.C. (2nd lieut.), 1917; lieut., R.A.F., 1918-20; med. offr., Zanzibar, 1926.

GORDON, HON. SIR ALEXANDER, Kt. Bach. (1930).—Judge of sup. ct., New South Wales, 1910-28.

GORDON, CHARLES AUGUSTINE.—B. 1882; ed. Stonyhurst Coll., St. Edmund's Coll., Hert. and Edinburgh Univ. (faculty of law); writer to the signet (W.S.); war serv., France and Flanders, 1915-19 (The Royal Scots); asst. admr. m. Zanzibar, 1925; offr. admr. and jud. tr. Nigeria, 1929.

GORDON, SIR DAVID JOHN, Kt. (1925).—B. 1865; M.L.C. of S. Australia, 1913; pres., leg. coun. since July, 1932.

GORDON, GUY MONTGOMERY, B.A., T.C.D., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1885; mil. R.E. GORDON, HON. WESLEY ASHBY (Can.), K.C., M.P.—B. 1884; ed. at Osgoode Coll. and Osgoode Hall; 1st el. to H. Canada, g.e., July, 1930; min. of immigr. colonization in Bennett cabinets, Aug., 1931; elec. by accl. after assuming office, Aug., also min. of lab., Feb., 1932.

GORDON-HALL, WILLIAM ALBERT, B. 1894; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Trinity Oxford; cadet, F.M.S., Oct., 1919; M.V.I., Mar., 1923; dist. offr., Kuala Lumpur, May, 1926; offr., cls. III., May, 1931; dist. Krian, May, 1932; ag. sec., res., Selangor.

GORING, GEORGE INGHAM, A.R.T.C. (gow), A.M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1890; ed. Alton Sch.; asst. mech. engrn., col. transport; asst. Br. Guiana; ag. ch. mech. engrn., transport, harbors dept., Nov., 1932-Aug., 1933; ch. engrn., Sept., 1933.

GORMLEY, CHARLES HENRY.—B. 1894; Dover County Schl. and Reading Univ.; Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1927; asst. dist. May, 1929.

GOSDEN, MINNIE, M.B., B.S., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—War serv., V.A.D. nurse, 1914-17; chem. pathologist, Hale chem. lab., London hosp., 1925; past asst., 1926; asst. bacteriological dept., 1927; med. offr., Lingfield Epileptic Colony, bacteriologist, Cyprus, Feb., 1929.

GOSLING, WILLIAM RICHARD, B.A.—ed. Sutton Valence and Cambridge Univ.; in France, the Balkans and Turkey, 1914-18; demob. with rank of major, 1919; asst. coms., Gold Coast, May, 1920.

GOSTELOW, CECIL, F.I.A. (Lond.).—ed. Fort St. Model High Schl., Sydney; actuary, N.Z. nat. provident fund, 1921; actuary, N.Z. govt. life insurance dep., actuary, govt. life insurance and friendly dep., 1923; also sec., govt. life insurance, govt. actuary, 1926.

GOTT, JOHN BURY.—B. 1890; ed. Coll. and Oriel Coll., Oxford; supr., educ. N. Provs., Nigeria, May, 1922.

GOURLAY, WILLIAM NEWLAND.—cadet, S.S., May, 1920; offr., cls. V., Feb., asst. dist. judge, Apr., 1925; offr., cls. IV., 1926; 3rd mag. Singapore, Jan., 1929;

ULD, Lieut.-Col. Hon. Sir Albert John, K.T., M.C., B.A. (1898).—B. 1847; solr., M.L.A., N. Rhodesia, 1881-98; M.L.C., 1899-1901; min. for mines in Reid ministry, 1894-8; returned to the senate of Commonwealth parlmt., 1901; min. of the senate, Feb., 1907, to June, 1910; retired from politics.

POWERS, Sir William Frederick, K.C.M.G. (1926), C.M.G. (1919), M.A., Barrister-at-law (Inner Temple).—B. 1875; ed. Rugby School, 1891; Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A. 1898 (1st clas., hon. trip); entd. service of B.S.A. Co., Jan., 1900; asst. native commr., Matabeleland 1900; commr., 1902; 3rd cls. res., N. Nigeria, Dec., 1902; 2nd cls. res., 1906; 1st cls. res., 1910; chief sec., Sept., 1912; lieut.-gov., N. Nigeria, June, 1921; gov. of Uganda, 1925-32; crown agt. for the cols., 1st July, 1932.

AEME, Alexander William Sutherland, M.A., Mech.E.B. 1882; ed. Malvern, pupil, 1892-6; held various appts. on Eng. Scottish rly.; dep. loco. supt., F.M.S. rlys., 1915-24; ag. loco. supt., F.M.S. rlys., 1917, Apr., 1919, Mar., 1922, Dec., 1923; supt., F.M.S. rlys., Mar., 1924; ch. mech., F.M.S. rlys., Oct., 1932.

RAHAM, Capt. Bernard James.—B. 1882; educ. S. African war, 1899-1902; Cape Garrison Artillery, 1899-10; 2nd lieut., N. Rhodesia pol., June, 1917; temp. major and 2nd in commd., N. Rhodesia Pol. Service Batt., June, 1918; commd. in desps.; hon. capt., Aug., 1919; commd. town and dist. pol., C.I.D., Livingstone, emigr. offr., N. Rhodesia and supt., Livingstone prison, July, 1920; offr. commd. N. Rhodesia pol., supt., cent. prison and dist. commd., volunteers, Mongu, Barotse, Apr., 1923; ditto, Livingstone, Jan., 1923; ditto, Fort Mason, Dec., 1923; capt., N. Rhodesia pol., 1924; J.P. for N. Rhodesia; ag. commd., 1933.

RAHAM, Rt. Hon. George Perry, P.C., M.L.D.—B. 1859; ed. High schls., Iroquois and Morristown, Ontario; journalist; Morristown, Ont.; Ottawa Free Press, Brockville Recorder; elected to Ontario legislature for Brockville, 1898, 1902, 1905, 1908, and 1905; provcl. sec. of Ontario, 1904; leader of the opposition in the Ontario legislature, 1907; sworn of the privy coun. for Canada and min. of rlyws. and canals, 1907; elected to the H. of C. for Brockville, by acclamation, 1907; defeated at g.e., 1911; re-elec. for S. Renfrew, bye-elec., 1912; did not seek re-election at gen.-elec., 1917; re-ele., g.e., 1921; min. of militia and defence, and of naval service in King admntr., Dec., 1921; min. of rlyws. and canals, 1922; senator, Dec., 1926.

RAHAM, James Mackay.—B. 1879; ed. Oxford Gram. Schl. and S. African Coll.; entd. Transvaal civ. ser., 1905; asst. mag., Johannesburg, 1916; mag., Heidelberg, 1927; ditto, Kimberley, 1930; ditto, Durban, 1933.

RAHAM, J. W., M.C., M.A., M.D., Ch.B. (Cantab.), Gold Med. (S. S.), Thesis in Trop. Med.—1896; mily. serv., 1914-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1925.

RAHAM, Sir. Thomas Lyneoch, K.T., M.C. (1920), K.C.—B. 1860; ed. at St. Andrew's Coll., Grahamstown, and Clare Coll., Camb.; M.A., barrister-at-law, Inner Temp., 1885; advoc. of sup. ct., Cape of Good Hope; M.L.C., 1898; atty.-gen., May to Oct., 1898; col. sec., 1900-1902; atty.-gen., 1902; ag. prime min., June to Aug., 1902; judge of sup. ct., Cape of Good Hope, July, 1904; judge pres., Eastern Districts local div., 15th Apr., 1913; chrmn. pub. serv. inquiry comm., June, 1918.

GRANNUM, Sir Edward Allan, K.T., Bach. (1926). C.M.G., 1915.—Passed Barbados, W. I., civ. ser. exam., 1886; 3rd cls. regar.'s off., Jan. to Oct., 1885; 2nd cls., Oct., 1885, to Nov., 1887; cls. master-in-chancery off., Nov., 1887, to June, 1888; honours graduate, diploma, Ontario Com. Coll., Canada, affiliated institute chartered accountants, Canada, Dec., 1889; practised public accountant, Barbados, W.I., to Aug., 1897; asst. auditor, Sierra Leone and Gambia, Sept., 1897, to Jan., 1900; acted auditor May to Nov., 1898; asst. auditor, Gold Coast and Lagos, Jan. to Mar., 1900; auditor, March, 1900; introduced system double entry accounts Gold Coast P.O., July, 1901; prepared scheme for introduction of double entry system of accounts for Accra town council, Aug., 1901; local auditor, Cyprus, 1902; auditor-gen., Mauritius, Apr., 1909; reovr.-gen., Mauritius, 1912; ag. col. sec., on various occasions, 1919-20 and 1922-23; col. sec., Aug., 1923; admst. govt. on various occasions, 1924-30; ret., 1931.

GRANNUM, Reginald Clifton, C.M.G. (1925).—B. 1872; 2nd cls. to gov., Windward Is., Sept., 1891; ditto, St. Vincent, Apr., 1892; supvr. of cust., G. Coast Col., Oct., 1893; asst. local audr., G. Coast and Lagos, May, 1896; local audr., S. Leone, June, 1896; J.P., S. Leone, 1897; ch. asst. treas., G. Coast, Apr., 1903; ag. treas. and mem. ex. and leg. couns., mem. bd. of educ., July, 1903, to June, 1904, Dec., 1904, to Dec., 1905, June, 1906, to May, 1907; Oct., 1907, to Sept., 1908; admitted student of Gray's Inn, Aug., 1908; reovr.-gen., B. Guiana, Sept., 1908; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., Dec., 1908; ag. govt. sec., July to Oct., 1913; deputy gov., Sept. to Oct., 1913; treas. and mem., exec. and leg. couns., Kenya, Sept., 1922.

GRANT, Charles Cameron, M.B.E.—Ed. Aberdeen Univ. (King's student); M.A., ditto, 1899; 2nd asst., Fraserburgh high schl., Aberdeenshire, 1899-1901; 1st asst., Aberlour high schl., Banffshire, 1901-2; priv. coun. certif., Scotch educn. dept., 1901; teacher, refugee camp, Springfontein, O.R.C., Nov., 1902; priv. govt. schl., Winburg, Jan., 1903; corprince, elk., educn. dept., Sept., 1904; admstve. clk., 1905; junr. clk., educn. dept., 1912; ag. sec., educn. dept., 1913; German S.W. Africa, 1914-15; M.B.E. for services in E. Africa, 1916-17; asst. regar., Univ. of S. Africa, 1918; regar., Univ. of S. Africa, 1922.

GRANT, D. K. S.—Asst. conservator of forests, E.A.P., Dec., 1912; conservator of forests, Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1920.

GRANT, Ezekiel Augustus.—Ent. British Honduras civ. serv. after compet. exam., as copyist to survey dept., Nov., 1899; 3rd cls. clk. (asst. keeper), King's warehouse, Feb., 1906; 2nd cls. clk., P.W.D., Apr., 1907; on active serv. with B.W.I. Regt. during war, Apr., 1916 to July, 1919; ag. 1st cls. clk., P.W.D., Aug., 1919 to Mar., 1920; acct., P.W.D., Apr., 1920; ag. clk. and storekeeper, P.W.D., Apr., 1921; ag. asst. inspr., schls., during 1921 to 1923; asst. inspr., schls., provisionally, Apr., 1923; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1928; dist. commsn., Orange Walk, Nov., 1928; ag. atty.-gen., Apr. to May, 1931; ag. dist. commsn., Belize and offl. adminstr. and offl. recr. from Apr., 1931.
GRANT, RICHARD WILLIAM, M.C.—B. 1897; ed. Jones' Sch., Mon. and Royal Mil. Acad., Woolwich; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1920; attd., col. secs., office, Dec., 1920; offr., cls V, dist. offr., N. Tobal, Nov., 1923; offr., cls IV, Nov., 1927; dist. offr., Bentong, Dec., 1929; asst. advr., K. Tinggi, Mar., 1930; offr., cls III, Nov., 1932; asst. advr., Segamat, Oct., 1933.

GRANT, THOS. ST. JOHN.—B.A., Dublin Univ., 1896; elk. to C. C. and R. M., Komgha, Cape Colony, Dec., 1897; ditto, East London, June, 1898; ditto, Port Elizabeth, Jan., 1899; passed Cape civ. serv. law exam., Feb., 1899; elk. atty.-gen.'s off., Cape Town, July, 1899; elk. to R. M., Cape, Oct., 1899; regiar. to judge pres. of high ct., Griqualand West, Sept., 1901; transf. to O.R.C. civ. serv. as asst. res. mag., Winburg, May, 1902; ditto, Bloemfontein, July, 1904; ag. res. mag., Bloemfontein, Nov., 1905, to Mar., 1906; res. mag., Hoopstad, 1907; mag., Bethulie dist., 1913; Parys, Feb., 1919; Newcastle, Sept., 1928; Queenstown, Oct., 1929; Kingwilliams Town, Aug., 1933.

GRANTHAM, ALEXANDER WILLIAM GEORGE HERDER, M.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1899; cadet, Hong-Kong, Nov., 1922; attd., C.S.O., 1925; 2nd pol. mag., Sept., 1929; sec. retrenchment comte., July, 1930; asst. to P.M.G. in addn., July, 1930; dist. offr., South, in addn., Dec., 1930; extra asst. col. sec., and sec. to harbr. advisory comte., 1931; lat pol. mag. in addn., 1932; 2nd asst. col. sec. and dep. clk. of couns., June, 1933.

GRAVER, GEORGE STANLEY, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1898; ed. Devonport High Sch.; engr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1923.

GRAY, CHAS. EDGAR.—B. 1904; cler. asst., offr. recr.'s. office, Br. Guiana, 1919; 6th cls. offr., col. sec's. office, 1921; 5th cls. offr., 1923; 4th cls. offr., 1926; sec. to prisons comte., 1928; 2nd cls. clk., 1933; ag. prin. clk. and clk., exec. and leg. couns. in 1932 and 1933.

GRAY, H. W., O.B.E.—Office supt., lieut.-gov.'s off., E.A.P., May, 1908; elk. of the couns., Oct., 1908; asst. dist. consmr., 1911; dist. consmr., Kenya, Jan., 1920; ch. regiar. of natives, Jan., 1920.

GRAY, JOHN.—B. 1874; ed. Glasgow Univ. and F.C. Training Coll., Glasgow; held several educational appts. in Scotland and England; served in S. African war; supt., Brandfort refugee camp, 1902-3; prin., Hoopstad schl., O.F.S., 1903; 1st cls. clk., educn. dept., O.F.S., 1904; senr. clk., educn. dept., 1912; ag. sec., educn. dept., Nov., 1918; prin. clk., educn. dept., 1919; sec., educn. dept., 1921.

M.L.C., for various periods, 1923-31; ag. state surgn., Kedah, Sept., 1931.

GRAY, JOHN MACFARLANE, L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S. (I), L.M. (Rot.), D.P.H. (Univ. Dub.)—B. 1898; health offr., med. dept., Hong Kong, 1933.

GRAY, R.—B. 1880; elk. treasy., 1902; elk. rev. dept., 1904; dep. recr., rev., Lichtenburg, 1905; elk. rev. dept., Jo'burg, 1908; Pretoria, 1912; prin. clk., 1921; survr., 1928; acctnt., 1929; recr., rev., E. London, 1931; do., Pretoria, 1932; do., Durban, 1933.

GRAY, SIR REGINALD, KT. BACH. (1920 K.C. (1908).—B. 1851; called to the bar, Inner L.t., 1875; compiled, in 1884, Bermuda laws from 1690-1883; revising offr., Bermuda laws, 1894; compiled, in 1903, Bermuda laws from 1690; counsel to statute law consolidation comte., 1900; atty.-gen., Bermuda, 28th May, 1901; chief just. in Oct. and Nov., 1911; ex-officio mem. of exec. coun.; M.L.A., 1895-1897, 1904-1906 and from 1907; ret.

GRAY, MAJOR WILLIAM BAIN.—B. 1872; ed. George Watson's Coll., Edinburgh; Univ. of Edinburgh; M.A., 1st cls. hon.; Gladstone Prizewinner and Ph.D., and New Coll., Oxford, B.Litt.; part-time Carnegie Research Fellow; lect., Tech. Coll., Brighton; examnr., Univ. of Edinburgh, Univ. and Cambridge joint bd. and Oxford local exam.; 2nd lieut., 6th Batt., the Royal Scots, Feb., 1915; mob., Aug., 1914; adjt., Jan.-Dec., 1915; capt., Aug., 1916; gen. staff, Alderhot comnd., Feb.-Aug., 1918-Apr., 1921; major, Army Biucl. Guiana, Oct., 1924; (app't. admin. dir., Nov., 1927); mem., educn. coman., Nov., 1924; chmn., Georgetown public free lib., May, 1926; mem., ct. of policy and educn., June, 1927; chmn. diamond and gold industries coman., Sept., 1927; mem. first exec. of leg. couns. under reformed constitution, Jan., 1928; ag. col. sec. and gov.'s dep. on various occasions.

GREAVES, AUBREY VERNON, M.B. (T.M.C.P. & S. (Ont.), D.T.M. (Liverpool).—B. 1876; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and Univ. of Toronto; Med. med. in trop. med. Univ. of Liverpool; on active serv. as capt., Canadian A.M.C., 1916-19; govt. bacteriologist and asst. med. of health and med. offr. in charge V.D. clinic and infant welfare clinic in addn., 1926; sent to Miami, Florida, to investigate epidemic of smallpox, 1926; ag. ch. med. offr., Apr.-Dec., 1927; bacteriologist, Bahamas, 1928; asst. bacteriologist, Hong Kong, 1929; bacteriologist, 1931; lecturer forensic med. and toxicology, Univ. of Hong Kong.

GREAVES, SIR WILLIAM HERBERT, K.B.A. (1904), K.C.—B. 1857; B.A., Oxon; honours, juris., 1879; called to the bar, Tem., 1880; ag. mbr.-gen., Barbados, Aug.-Sept., to July, 1885, and July, 1886, to Jan., 1887; confirmed; J.P., Sept., 1885; exchequer-gen., Q.C. for Barbados, 1890; mem. exec. coman., acted as atty.-gen., July to Dec., 1887, and July to Dec., 1891; mem. of house of assem., act. of educn., 1888-1902; atty.-gen., Mar., 1902; just., Apr., 1902; ret.

GRECH, WINDHAM, LL.D. (Malta).—B. 1891; Called to the bar (Grays Inn), 1916; 2nd cls. R.F.C., 1916; capt., R.A.F., 1918; esp. Malta and Rome, 1917; attd., Italian Sup. Com., 1918-19 (Chevalier, Crown of Italy); unemployed list (R.A.F.), 1919; ass't. adviser, Seychelles, 1921; ag. legal adviser, crown prov., 14th Mar., 1921 to 25th Sept., 1922; and in 1924; ag. ch. just., Dec., 1923 to July, 1924, Mar.-Oct., 1925 and Apr. to July, 1927.

GREEN, CLAUDE.—B. 1879; ed. Temp. civ. serv., Mar., 1886; ch. clk. to gen. man. of hwys., Mar., 1897.
KEN, FREDERICK WALTER VICTOR.—B. ed. Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana; 6th cls. ist., 1914; asst. comary., 1917; sec., excise July, 1923; 3rd gde. comary., July, 1925; offr., dist. admtn., Jan., 1932.

KEN, GEORGE.—B. 1894; ed. Westminster chl.; on mil. serv., Oct., 1914 to Mar., 2nd lieut., The Buffs; wounded in France; clk., C.O., Oct., 1919 to Feb., 1920; miny., Sept., 1920 to Dec., 1920; C.O., Dec., June, 1922; apptd. cler. offr., O.C.O., 21st June, 1922; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st June, 1928.

KEN, GEORGE C.—B. 1882; apptd., after exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. and assigned to C.O., 26th Aug., 1901; cler. higher grade, 1st Apr., 1922.

KEN, GEORGE C., M.B.E. (1926)—B. 1897; asst. sec., sec. office, Br. Guiana, 1912; clk., 1913; 3rd cls. clk., 1918; sec. to for considering disposal of colonial lands, 2nd cls. clk., 1920; sec. to civ. serv., 1923; sec., Br. Guiana section, Wembley, prin. clk., 1924; sec., rly. coman., 1925; offr., partly delegation to Br. Guiana, sec., Br. Guiana delegation to W. Indian London, 1926; sec., civ. serv. coman., 7; ag. 2nd astt. col. sec. and clk. exec. and coun., various occasions, 1925-30; sec., iana constitution comsn., 1927; pvt. sec., in 1938; 2nd astt. col. sec., 1930; astt. l., 1931.

KEN, HAROLD.—B. 1887; ed. at Queen Gram. Schl., Hants.; entd. Royal botanic s., Kew, 1907; astt. supt., botanical and y dept., Hong Kong, 1911; seconded for rv., 1917-20; astt., botanical and forestry Hong Kong, 1920; J.P., 1922.

KEN, MAURICE JOHN, V.D.—B. 1878; ed. int pub. schl. and S.A. Coll.; astt. clk. of Cape H. of A., 1896; clk. of papers, 1897; clk., Cape leg. coun., 1904, and Union 1910; gent. ush., black rod, 1916; clk., 1926; clk. of senate, 1930; sworn trans. Dutch; sec. and shorthand writer various omana; astt. sec. speaker's confos. on future senate; war serv., Anglo-Boer, in W.P.M.R., war, in Ger. S.W. Afr. as nav. trnsp. in Harwich light cruiser, squad. and war secretariat; comdr., cdmg. Cape Town flys. and harbours, 13th July, 1908; Natal deleg. to S. African National Convention, Oct., 1908 to May, 1909; represented Natal at Impl. Confos. on defence, 1909; mem., rly. and harbours bd., Union of S. Africa, 1910 to 1916.

GREENE, MAURICE CHESTER.—B. 1881; ed. at Ratho's schl. and St. Stephen's Green schl., Dublin, and Dublin Univ.; B.A. 1905; student, King's Inns, Dublin, 1910-11; dist. offr., N. Nigeria, July, 1912; served with W.A.F.F., 1914-15; station mag., 1918; pol. mag., 1920; pres., dist. ct., Cyprus, Mar., 1928.

GREENFIELD, LIEUT.-COL. HERBERT, O.B.E., R. of O.—B. 1880; ed. privately; served in S. African War, 1901-02; joined R.A.V.C.; lieut., May, 1903; served in India, 1903-08; capt., May, 1908; attd. staff coll., 1910-12; sp. serv. and research work, N. and S. China, 1912-14; served in Great war, 1914-18 Tsingtau operns.; major, July, 1915; D.A.D.V.S., 10th divn., Gallipoli, Greater Macedonia, Serbia, Bulgaria, 1915-16; temp. lieut.-col., 1916; D.A.D.V.S., France and Belgium, 1917-18; ment. in desps.; A.D.V.S. (lieut.-col. temp.) Rhine Army, 1919; served in Waziristan operns., 1920 as D.A.D.V.S. and D.D.V.S. (temp. lieut.-col.) Wazir Force, 1920-21; ment. in desps.; D.A.D.V.S., India and Burma, 1921-24; exec. duty, Aldershot, 1925-28; vety. offr., Barbados, Oct., 1928.

GREENHALGH, N., B.Sc., Hons. (Vict.).—B. 1888; agric. and science master, Antigua gram. schl., 1910; lecturer in agric. science to students of training coll., Antigua; astt. inspr. of schl., Barbados, 1912; lecturer in educ. and master of method, training inst., Codrington Coll.; ag. chief inspr. of schl., Trinidad, June to Oct., 1915.

GREENHILL, MARCUS ARTHUR.—B. 1899; entd. C.O., Sep., 1914; apptd. after compet. exam., astt. clk., C.O., Oct., 1916; on military service, May, 1917 to Feb., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st June, 1929.

GREENIDGE, CHARLES WILTON WOOD.—B. 1889; eduo. Harrison Coll., Barbados, and Downing Coll., Camb.; B.A. (Nat. Sci. Tripos)1910; LL.B., 1911; called to bar, Mid. Term., 1912; 1st cls. hon. criminal law; admitted to bar, Barbados, 1915; mag., dist. D. St. Kitts, 1919; mag. dist. D. Barbados, 1923; judge, ot. of apl., Barbados, 1926, mag., Port of Spain, Trinidad, 1927; ag. solr.-gen., Oct., 1928 to June, 1929; ag. puisne judge in 1929; ag. atty.-gen., Oct. to Nov., 1929; ag. regiar., Oct.-Nov., 1930; ag. solr.-gen., Jan., 1931; ch. just., Br. Honduras, 1932.

GREENLAND, STANLEY ARTHUR.—Served with Natal Field Force, Rebellion, 1906; clk., govt., sec. dept., Papua, Mar., 1912; J.P., Sept., 1912; ag. astt. res. mag., Iona, May, 1913; ag. astt. res. mag., Kairuku, Mar., 1915; inspr., dept. native affairs, Mar., 1917; ag. curator, intestate estates, regist.-gen., etc., Apr., 1917; ag. ch. inspr., native affairs, 1918; ag. Papua gov't. agt., Sydney, N.S.W., Dec., 1919; travelling inspr., native affairs, July, 1922; J.P. for N.S.W., Oct., 1923; ag. mem., land bd., Papua, Nov., 1924; ch. inspr., native affairs, Dec., 1924.

GREENWAY, PEYOT JAMES, F.L.S.—B. 1897; ed. East Anglian Inst. of Agr., Chelmsford, R. Horticultural Soc., Wisley, Ripley, and R. Botanic Gardens, Kew; mily. serv., France and Italy, 1916-19; herbarium astt., R. Botanic Gardens, Kew, 1922-25; do., and ag. demonstr.
in systematic botany, Imp. Forestry Inst., Oxford, 1926-28; systematic botanist, E. African agrl. research sta., Amani, Tanganyika Territory, 1928.

GREGOROWSKI, REGINALD ADDINGTON.—2nd clk., govt. sec.'s office, O.F.S., Dec., 1895; priv. sec. to state pres., Mar., 1896; landrost clk., Bethlehem, Dec., 1897; priv. sec. to state pres., July, 1898; landrost clk., Wepener, Jan., 1899; prin. govt. schl., Reddersburg, O.R.C., Oct., 1900; ast. clk., educ. dept., Mar., 1901; ch. clk. and regis., educ. dept., July, 1901; prin. clk., col. sec.'s off., June, 1909; ch. clk. to admstn., O.F.S. prov., Aug., 1910; prov. sec., O.F.S., Oct., 1924.

GREGORY, CHARLES WILLIAM, M.B.E. (1919).—Natal Mounted pol. (Zululand), 1896-1901; attached to Army Service Corps, 1901-1902; chief storekeeper, central stores, Pretoria, Transvaal repatriation department, 1902-1904; Transvaal civ. ser., 1906; chief storekeeper, P.W.D., East Africa Prot., Sept., 1906.

GREGORY, HON. FRANCIS BROOKE, LL.B.—B. 1862; ed. at pub. schls. and Harvard Univ.; admtd., an atty., New Brunswick, 1884, and called to the bar, 1885; called to the bar, B. Columbia, 1890; regis. of probate et., York Co., New Brunswick, 1885-1890; French cons. agt. at Victoria, B. Columbia, 1904-1909; commd. 6th regt. Canadian garr. artil. at Victoria, B. Columbia, 1898-1903; lieut.-col., reserve of offrs. (Canadian Militia); mem. of Diamond Jubilee contingent to England, 1897; on spec. ser. to Alaska in connection with Behring sea fisheries dispute, 1891-2; judge of sup. ct., B. Columbia, Nov., 1909.

GREGORY, HON. HENRY.—B. 1860; M.L.A., for N. Coolgardie, W. Australia, 1897; ditto for Menzies since 1901; min. for mines, 1901-2, and 1902-4; min. for mines and rly., Aug., 1908; ditto, 16th Sept., 1910, to Oct., 1911; mem. H. of R., C. of A., 1913.

GREIG, CLINTON HENRY, O.B.E. (1920).—B. 1875; entd. cust. dept., B. Guiana, 1895; sub. inspr., B. Guiana pol., Dec., 1900; 2nd lieut.(unatt.), B. Guiana militia, Dec., 1900; on sp. serv. to Trinidad (after riots), Apl. to July, 1903; inspr., pol., Trinidad, and comdt. Port of Spain fire brigade, Sept., 1903; capt., Trinidad local forces, May, 1905; sp. certif. (captain's), inf. training, schl. of instr., Chelsea Barracks, London, and Hythe certif. (musketry), D., 1905; ast. supt., pol., Gambia, Aug., 1910; comntr. pol., sheriff and inspr. of prisons, July, 1911; ag. ch. mag., Gambia, July to Oct., 1912; capt. comdgs. Gambia volr. artil., Sept., 1912; ag. rec-gen. in 1912 and 1914; ag. offr-in-charge of secretariat, and provvn. M.L.C., 1912; provsnl. M.E.C., Dec., 1913; on active serv. in Cameroons, June, 1915, to Mar., 1916; dist. offr., with judicial powers, Duala prov., Cameroons, July, 1915; apptd. hon. capt. in the Army (for services with Cameroons Exped. Force), as from Mar., 1916; temp. capt., W.A.F.F., Gambia, May, 1917; mem., African taxation comte., 1921; del. to confce. of W. African contrs. of cust., London, 1921.

GREIG, GORDON FASTLEY, A.R.S.M.—B. 1879; ed. Wellington Coll., and Royal Schl. of Mines, London; inspr. of mines, F.M.S., 1902; ag. ast. warden, Palang, 1907; ast. warden, Perak, 1910; ag. warden, Selangor, 1914; ag. warden, Perak, 1916 and 1920; ag. senr. warden of mines, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; warden of mines, Perak, Mar., 1921; senr. warden of mines, F.M.S., Feb., 1922.

GRELL, JESSIE MITCHINSON POTTER, M.P.—B.S. Cantab., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., entd. med. serv., Trinidad, June, 1908; dist. med. offr., Aug., 1912.

GRENFELL-HICKS, J. B.—B. 1891; Rhodesian pol., 1911-16; lieut., Rhodesian Nat. Regt., 1916-19; Rhodesian adminstr., 1919-22; ast. supt., Kenya pol., Nov., 1920; staff off., 1923; supt., 1926.

GRENIER, NORMAN ST. JOHN CHARLES.—B. 1879; clk., ser., Perak, 1894; ag. ast. aud., F.M.S., Apr., 1902; ast., audit dept., F.M.S., Jan., 1904; financl. ast., P.W.D., Perak, Jan., 1906; secy., san. bd., Selangor, Mar., 1911; regis., vehicle, Selangor, Mar., 1913; ast. audr., Selangor, Negri Semilan and Penang, 1919; ag. rev. audr., Perak, 1920 and 1921; state treas., Perak, 1920; ag. ast. aud., F.M.S., 1921; ast., P.W.D., F.M.S., 1924.

GRETTON, RONALD HENRY.—B. 1897; King George High Schl., Vancouver, Canada; Univ. of Br. Columbia, B.A.; ast. audr., Nigeria, 1929; transferred to Gambia, 1931; sec. and A.D.C., 1931 and 1933; ast. co., 1932; clk. of couns., 1933.

GRICE, NORMAN, B.A. (Cantab.).—F. cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1920; astd., Chinese sect., Perak, Feb., 1923; astd., cust. dept., Mar., 1925; astd., Chinese sect., Jan., 1925; ast. prot. sect., Selangor, Jan., 1925; ast. supt., gov't. pol., Penang, Feb., 1927; ast. contr. sect., S'pore, Mar., 1927; ast. dist. judge, S'pore, addn., Aug., 1927; cl. III, Oct., 1929; 2nd cl. S'pore, Sept., 1933.

GRIEK, Sir SELWYN MACGREGOR, K.T. (1934), C.M.G. (1929).—B. 1878; ed. Marlboro' Coll. (classical scholar) and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge (classical scholar); 2nd clas. tripus, 1900; 1st class French and Eng. special, 1901; B.A. 1900; called to the bar, Nov., 1910; ast. rea., Northern Nigeria, 1910; part. in Hausa, 1907; 3rd class rea., Int. coll., in charge of Zaria prov., April, 1910; and in Zaria to May to Nov., 1911; sec., native affrs., Nigeria, Jan., 1921; col. sec., Trinidad, Aug., 1925; gov', Aug., 1922 to Mar., 1930, and from Jan., 1932.

GRIERSON, CHARLES HENRY ALEXANDER.—B. 1889; ed. privately and St. Paul's Sch.; served local forces and 2nd Batt. Loyal N. Lancs. Regt. in E. African campaign, Aug. 1914 to Feb., 1920; Turkana expdn., 1915; ast. polit. sec., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1916; admin. 1st grade, Apr., 1921; dep. prov. commr., Jan., 1926; prov. commr., Feb., 1930.

GRIFFIN, ARTHUR WILFRID MICHAEL SWART, M.C. (1919).—B. 1887; ed. Harrow, Trinity Coll., Cambridge; B.A. 1910; barrister-at-law, 1919; probationer, N.E. Rhodesia, 1919; ast. native commr., July, 1922; prov. commr., Apr. 1913; N.R. Rifles, Jan., 1923; commd. on N. Rhodesia pol., 1915-19; ast. gen., Nov., 1923; prov. commr., Apr., 1929.

GRIFFIN, SIR CHARLES JAMES, K.T. (1923), K.C., Ireland (1920), K.C., Great Britain (1914).—B. 1875; B.A. (hona.), Royal Irish Acad.; 1st scholar in modern literature exhibition; Chancellor's gold medallist; ed. the Irish Bar, June, 1898; went Consul circuit; apptd. Crown prosecutor, B.C.A. Protorate (now Nyasaland), July, 1901; ag. judicial offr. and H.B.M. vice-consul, Nov., 1901 to June, 1902; ag. judge of High Court, Feb., 1902, Oct., 1904 and Nov., 1905 to Feb., 1906; gen., Nov., 1905; judge of High Court, Feb., 1906.
member of H.B.M. Court of Appeal for

ce of proceedings; K.C. for the colony,
1914; chief justice, Leeward Is., 1919; sole

1921; ch. just., high ct., Uganda,
2; sole commr. for revision of laws of
la., 1923, and reed. thanks of govt. in coun.;
Batakaland commr., 1924.

FFIN, Nevill Alfred Malcolm.—B.
ed. Blundell's; pol. probationer, S.
1908; Feb., 1911; ast. supt. pol., Penang,
1912; ast. supt. pol., Malacca and ast.
Chinese, July, 1912; seconded, Kedah,
1914; adjt., S.S. pol., Oct., 1916; supt. pol.
J.), Penang, Mar., 1923; C.P.O., Perak,
1931; dep. commr., pol., Selangor, 1932.

FFITH, Carl.—Asst. auditor, gold Coast,
1920.

FFITH, Gerald Victor Alexander, B.A.,
Ch., B.A.O. (Dublin).—B. 1903; med.
med. dept., Hong Kong, 1930; med. offr. in
officers' families, Victoria Gaol, infectious
hosp. and pol. surg., Hong Kong, 1931.

FFITH, Sir Wm. Brandford, K.T. Bach.
—B. 1858; Gilchrest scholar, 1877; B.A.
1880; called to the bar, Mid. Term., June,
ag. Queen's advoc., G. Coast Col., Apr. to
84; dist. commr., 1885; ag. puisane judge,
Jan., and Cape Coast, May, 1886; ag.
advoc., 1886 and 1887; compiled ordi-
of G. Coast Col., 1887; res. mag., Jamaica,
R.M., St. Catherine, Feb., 1893; ag. atty.
ay to Dec., 1893; ch. just., G. Coast Col.,
895; admstd. govt. of Lagos, July to
396; dep. for gov. G. Coast, Aug. to Nov.,
avised ordinances of G. Coast Col., 1896
3; retired, 1911.

FFITHS, J. A., F.R.C.V.S., F.Z.S.—
ffr., Nyassaland, 1913; ch. vety. offr.,
nd, 1919; dep. ch. vety. offr., Nigeria,

FFITHS, Jeffrey Arthur, F.R.C.V.S.—
Ed. Univ. of Liverpool; veterinary offr.,
id, 7th June, 1913; attached Intell. Corps,
id Field Force, Aug., 1914 to July, 1917;
to rinderpest commr., German E. Africa,
17 to May, 1919; ag. rinderpest commr.,
18 to May, 1919; chief vet. offr., 14th
9; ment. in desps. (gallantry in action)
rica, 1901; ment. in desps. services with
ce, Nyassaland, 1915 and 1917; ag. dir. of
to Dec., 1920.

FFITHS, John Harold Crofto.—B.1895;
own County Sch., and Univ. Coll. of
served in France and Mesopotamia, 1915-
N. Rhodesia, Feb., 1918; ast. native
Sept., 1919; native commr., Jan., 1920;
Jan., 1928; dist. offr., grade II, Apr.,
sec., Apr., 1929; ag. prin. asth. sch. sec.
nd 1931.

ITHS, Lieut. Noel Stewart, R.N.—
ed., Leatherhead Schl.; supt., educn.
Provs., Nigeria, 5th Apr., 1922.

ITHS, W., A.M.I.E.E.—Imp. Post
99; R.N.A.S., 1915; twice ment. in
insfd., unemployed list, 1919; seconded,
d Uganda as engnr. ast., 1920; ast.
1922; ag. tel. engr., 1923.

Sir Edward William Macleay,
(1928), K.C.V.O. (1920), C.M.G. (1919),
C.V.O. (1919), D.S.O. (1918), M.C.—B. 1879;
ed. Winchester (schol.) and New Coll., Oxford
(schol.); 2nd cls. mods., 1900, 3rd cls. lit. hum.;
1902, Galsfords Greek Verse Prize, 1902; joined
editorial staff "Times," 1903; ast. edr.
"Outlook," 1906-6; rejoined editorial staff of
"Times," 1908; joined Grenadier Guards, 1914;
became G.S.O.I., Guards divn.; mil. sec. to
Prince of Wales, Canada, Australia, N.Z., 1919;
relinquished commr. with rank of lieut.-col., 1921;
prv. sec., Mr. Lloyd George, 1921-22; sec.,
Rhodes trustees, 1923; M.P., Oldham, 1923-25;
gov. and commr.-in-ch., and high commr. for
transport, Kenya, 1926-31.

GRIMBLE, Athub Francis, M.A., F.R.A.I.—
B. 1888; ed. Magdalene Coll., Cambridge, France,
Germany; cadet, Gilbert and Ellice Is., Mar.,
1914; passed cadet, Mar., 1915; dep. commr.
for W. Pacific, Aug., 1915; ag. dist. offr., Tarawa,
Mar., 1916; dist. offr., Aug., 1916; cent. Gilberts,
Feb., 1917; S. Gilberts, Oct., 1918; sp. commr.
to settle native land disputes throughout col.
and organise records, Jan., 1920; ag. res. commr.,
Apr., to July, 1920 and Jan. to Feb., 1922; 1st
dist. offr., 1924; ag. res. commr., Mar. to Sept.,
1924; res. commr., Gilbert and Ellice Is., 1926;
adminstr., St. Vincent, July, 1933.

GRIMMER, Ward Chipman Hazen, K.C.,
LL.D.—B. 1858; admitted atty., 1880; barrister,
1881; K.C., 1902; elected to prov. legin., N.
Brunswick, 1903; re-elected, 1908, 1912; surv.-gen.,
N. Brunsw., 1908; atty.-gen., 1911; puisane judge,
appeal ct. of N. Brunsw., Jan., 1914.

GRINDLEY-FERRIS, Ivon K.C., B.A. (Cape).
B.A., LL.B. (Cantab.).—B. 1876; ed. Diocesan
Coll., Rondebosch; admitted barrister, Inner
Temple, June, 1900; advoc., sup. ct., Transvaal,
Nov., 1902; K.C., 1922; ag. judge, high ct.,
S.W. Africa in 1924 and 1928, and as judge,
Transvaal prov. divn. during 1927; judge pres.,
native high ct., Natal, Mar., 1930; seconded to
Natal prov. divn., sup. ct., May, 1930; judge,
sup. ct., Transvaal prov. divn., 1933.

GRIST, Donald Honey, Camb. Univ. Dip. of
Agric.—B.1891; ed. Huntingdon Grammar Schl.,
Camb. County Schl. and Camb. Univ. Schl.
of Agr.; agric. instr., agric. dept., F.M.S.,
June, 1914; on duty in Ceylon, Feb., 1921; ag.
agric. instr., Sultan Idris Coll., Tanjong Malim,
in addn., Dec., 1922; agric. economist, 1924; ag.
regis.-gen., statistics, S.S. and F.M.S. in addn.,
June, 1931; agric. economist and edr., S.S. and
F.M.S., Sept., 1931.

GRIST, Major H. G., R. of O., R. Fusiliers.—
B. 1881; ed. Aldenhams Schl., Herts., 2nd lieut.,
7th bn., R. Fusiliers, 1899; lieut., 1900; capt.,
1903; R. of O., 1907; S. African War, Queen's
med.; capt., 14th (S.) bn., Northumberland
Fusiliers, Nov., 1914; B.E.F., France, 1915-19;
major, Oct., 1915; ag. lieut.-col., July-Oct., 1916;
staff capt., Abbeville area, 1918; ment. in desps.;
ch. of pol. and offr. commdg. local forces, St.
Vincent, Jan., 1924.

GROBLER, Hon. P. G. W., M.P.—Rep.
Rustenburg elec. divn. in Union of S. Africa
parlmt. since 1915; min. of lands, 30th June, 1924;
del., Ottawa Econ. Conf., 1932; min. for
native affrs., Mar., 1933.

GROOM, Hon. Sir Littleton Ernest,
K.C.M.G. (1924), K.C., M.A., LL.M.—B. 1867;
M.P. for Darling Downs, Queensland; elected to
last hse. of rep., O. of Aust., 1901; re-elected, Dec.,
1903; mem. of royal comm. on Iron Bonus,
1902, and Navigation Bills, 1904-5; several times
Crown prosecutor, and twice ag. judge of dist.
et al., Queensland; min. for home affairs, C. of Aust., July, 1905; atty.-gen., Oct., 1906; min. of external affairs, June, 1909, to Apr., 1910; min. of trade and customs, June, 1913-Sept., 1914; hon. min., Feb., 1917; vice-pres., exec. counc., Nov., 1917 to Mar., 1918; min. for works and railways, Mar., 1918; ag. atty.-gen. from Apr., 1918; atty.-gen., Dec., 1921; atty.-gen., Bruce ministry, 1923; speaker, house of rep., Jan., 1926-29; re-el., M.H.R., Dec., 1931.

GUILLEMARD, Sir Laurence Nunnis, G.C.M.G. (1927), K.C.B. (1910), K.C.M.G. (1923), C.B. (1906).—B. 1862; ed. Charterhouse and Trin. Coll. Camb.; entered Treasury, 1888; priv. sec. to Sir W. Harcourt and Sir M. Hicks-Beach, 1892-1902; deputy chmn., board of inland rev., 1902; chmn., bd. of customs and excise, 1903; gov., S. Stirlings, 7th Feb., 1920; ret., 1927.

GULLIBETT, Hon. Sir Henry Somke, K.C.M.G. (1933).—B. 1878; served Europe: War, 1915-18; dir., Australian War Museum and offl. historian, A.I.F. in Palestine; dir., Australian immigration bureau, Oct., 1920; M.H.R., O'Connell of Australia from 1925; min. for trade and custom, 1928-29; dep. leader of opposition, Nov., 1929; min. for trade and custom, Lyons' ministry, 1932.

GULLIVER, E. G.—Cust. asst., Kenya, July, 1916; collr., cust., Jan., 1926.

GULLOCH, William Sutherland.—B. 1883; 2nd lieut., Scottish Rifles, 1914; lieut., Scottish Rifles, 1916; lieut., Gold Coast Regt., 1918; capt., Gold Coast Regt., 1919; served France and Togoland; asst. commr., pol., Gold Coast, 1919; ag. commr., pol., Eastern prov., 1924-5; commr., pol., Cent. prov., 1926; ch. pol., Gibraltar, Nov., 1927.

GUMMER, Wallace Albert.—B. 1880; royal observatory, Greenwich, 1895; ditto, Cape of Good Hope, Jan., 1900; trig. survey, Transvaal and O.R.C., Feb., 1903; surv., rev. survey dept., Selangor, Nov., 1907; ditto, trig. br., Nov., 1914; supt., rev. surveys, Singapore, Aug., 1924; surv., Malacca, Mar., 1927; ditto, Kedah, Jly., 1929; supt., rev. surveys, Perak, 1932; senr. surv., 1933.

GUNARATNA, Walter Dandris, B.Sc. (Lond.)—B. 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1927; addl., Galle kach., Jan., 1928; addl., Kandy kach., May, 1928; ag. pol. mag., Dumbaree, Dec., 1928 to Jan., 1929; extra office asst., Batticaloa kach., Jan., 1929; office asst., Batticaloa kach., Jan., 1930; pol. mag., Puttalam, Oct., 1931; office asst., Badulla kach., Aug., 1932.

GUNASEKARA, Septimus Theodosius, L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), D.P.H. (Lond.), L.M.S. (Ceylon).—B. 1881; 1st house surg., gen. hosp., Colombo—Ceylon, Sept., 1904; med. offr., Kandy, Jan., 1907; ag. 3rd surg., gen. hosp., Colombo, Oct., 1908; dir., ankylostomiasis campaign, Dikoya and Amella, Oct., 1917 to Mar., 1920; sany. offr., Apr., 1920; ag. sany. commr., Oct., 1922; asst. dir., sany. services, Oct., 1925.

GUNAWARDANA, Don Charles Rajakaruna, B.A. (Lond.)—B. 1901; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1924; addl., Matara kach., Jan., 1925; ditto, Jaffna kach., Apr., 1926; pol. mag., Dandagamuwa, June, 1927; office asst., Batticaloa kach., Sept., 1928; asst. govt. agt., Ratnapura, Jan., 1930; do., Colombo, Jan., 1931; do., Batticaloa, Mar., 1931; office asst., Kandy kach., Dec., 1931.

GUNDY, John Arnold, A.M.I.E.E.—B. 1900; ed. St. Bees Schol. and Faraday House; engr.-li.-ch.'s office, G.P.O., Lond., 1920: asst. engr., posts and tele., Nigeria, Mar., 1929; engr., Mar., 1929; divnl. engr., Apr., 1930.

GUNN, Hon. John.—B. 1885; M.L.A., Adelaide, 1916; leader, party. Labor for 1918; premier and treas., S. Australia, 1926; mem., migration and development comm., Australia, 1926.

GUPPY, Robert.—Imperial postal ser., Mar., 1892; ch. clk. and acctt., post dept., G. Coast, 1900; ag. dir. of telegraph June to 26th July, 1901; acctt., 1902; present system of accounting passed in Comm. brought into force 1st Sept., 1902.

GURNEY, H. L. G.—Asst. dist. nat. Kenya, June 1921; ag. sec., secretariat, 1922.

GURUSINHA, Kankanana Thanaka, N.T. Tripatha—B. 1877; apptd. cl. V. Ordn. serv., Mar., 1923; office asst., Kalawala mar., 1923; addnl. asst. commr., stamp, May, 1930.

GUTHRIE, Hon. Hugh, P.C. (Can.), C.B.E., V.D.—B. 1866; ed. Coll. Inat. Guelph and Ont. Hall, Toronto; ed. to H. of C., Canada; 1900; re-el. at g. e., 1904, 1908, 1911, 1917, 1925 and 1926; solr. gen., Canada, 1917; militia and defence, 1920; min. of defence in Meighen adminstr., 1926; min. of and atty.-gen., in Bennett adminstr., 1930.

GUTSCHE, Hon. Clement, B.A., C.B.E., V.D.—B. 1877; ed. Dale Coll. in Williams Town and S. African Coll., Cap. (gold med., lit. and philos.); on active Anglo-Boer War (2 medls. and clasps); sent to Cape bar, 1904; edr., Cape Town, 1908-10; and joint edr., Repts. of Cap. Divn.; served in Great War, 1914-18; commr., Table Bay defences; Gen. Serv. medals, twice ment. in despatches, and V.D.; resumed professorship, law Coll., 1919; first judge, high ct., S. West, 1919; judge, eastern dista. local distr., Grahamstown, 1930.

GYBON-MONYPENNY, Richard Montague, B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1906; cadet, Com. serv., Dec., 1927; addl., Badulla kach., 1928; office asst., Kurunegala kach., Mat. pol. mag., Matale, Feb., 1933.

HAARER, Alex Ernest, F.L.S.—Ed. Birkenhead Inst., Battersea Gram. Sch.; Royal Horticultural Coll. (dipl. hort. agrl. offr.), Tanganyika Territory, 1931; agt., 1930.

HADDRIEL, Cyril F.—B. 1902; agt., compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 29th April.

HALES, Everett Olive.—B. 1886; pub. trust office, 1894; offr. in charge of branch, 1914; inspr., 1919; local dep. trustee, 1920; asst. pub. trustee, 1922; N.Z. state advances office, 1931.

HALFORD, Hon. W. W.—Elected M.P., Newfoundland, 1913; min. of agri. mines, 1917; M.E.C., 1917; col. sec., 1918.

HALL, Guthrie.—B. 1897; Cheshire Rgt., 1915; lieut., 1917; served Waziristan Field Force, 1919; asst. dist. nat. Gold Coast, 1921.

HALL, J. D., B.A. (Oxon).—Cadet S.S., 1910; passed cadet, July, 1913; supernumerary cls. V; asst. adviser, Batu Pahat, Johor, 1914; supernumerary offr., cls. IV, Dec.; 3rd assist. ool. sec., Apr., 1920; cls. III, New pte. sec. to gov. and high commr., Nov., cls. II., Nov., 1927; adviser, land office, 1930; offr., cls. IB., Apr., 1930; asst. commr., Aug., 1930; Br. advr., Kedah, Mr.
HALLIDAY, L. G.—B. 1883; ed. Holt Schl. and Liverpool Univ.; mily. serv., Mesopotamia, 1916-1920; ch. engr., "Lord Milner," Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1924; in charge, reconditioning "Liamba," Dec., 1925; ch. engr., "Liamba," 1927.

HALLIER, CAPT. FRANK COLLINGS, M.C., R. of C.—B. 1888; U.D.F. and Cape Corps, 1913-18; S. African Rebellion and German S.W. Africa, 1914-16; G.E.A., 1916-18; seconded as asst. pol. offr., civ. admin., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1918; admin. offr., 1st gde., Feb., 1922; dep. prov. commnr., 1933.

HALLIFAX, JOHN GORDON, C.S.L.L.—B. 1883; clk., law dept. (Cape), 1903; clk., pub. serv. commnr., 1913; ch. clk., ditto, 1927; pub. serv. inspr., 1930.

HALL-JONES, HON. SIR WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1910)—B. 1851; ed. at public schla.; arrived in New Zealand, 1875; mem. of house of representatives for Timaru, New Zealand, 1890-1908; min. of pub. wks. and marine, 1896; premier col. treas., min. for educn. and labour, June, 1906; resig. premiership, and assumed portfolios of pub. wks. and rly. in Ward ministry, Aug., 1906; high commr. in Lond., 1908-1912; M.L.C. since 1913.

HALLOCK, ANANDA RAJAH.—B. 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1927; attd. Puttalam kach., Dec., 1927; attd., Kalutara kach., Nov., 1928; office asst., ditto, Oct., 1929; ditto, Jaffna kach., Feb., 1931; pol. mag., Puttalam, July, 1932.

HALLOWES, BRABAZON HENRY COLLIS, B.A., B.A.I.—B. 1884; ed. Corrig Sch., Kingstown and Trinity Coll., Dublin; survr., valuation and bindry. survey of Ireland, 1910; 2nd cls. survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1914; capt., R.F.A., 1914-19; 1st cls. survr., 1921.

HAM, GORDON Lupton.—B. 1885; ed. King Edward's Schl. and Christ's Coll., Camb.; B.A.; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1908; lent to Kelantan, Oct., 1913; cls. IV., S. S., Jan., 1918; clk. of couns., Sept., 1919; 1st asst. ool. seo., S. S. and clk. of couns., Jan., 1920; asst. offl. assignee, Dec., 1920; ag. sec. to high commnr., Feb., 1921; ag. asst. adviser to govt. of Kelantan, Apr., 1921; ag. 1st asst. sec. B. S. S., Apr., 1922; ag. dep. treas. (B), S.S., Dec., 1924; ag. dep. treas. (A), Mar., 1925; ols. II., Nov., 1925; sec. to res., Perak, Nov., 1925; cls. IB., Jan., 1927; pres., munic. commnr., Penang, May, 1927; Br. advr., Trengganu, Mar., 1931; offr., cls. I.A., dep. pres., munic. commnr., Sp'ore., Nov., 1932; under sec. S.S., Aug., 1933.

HAM, HENRY SOMERSET McKENZIE.—B. 1878; ocl., recr. of rev., O.F.S., 1900; clk., deeds, Bloemfontein, 1901; ch. clk. and examr., deeds, Bloemfontein, 1904; asst. regisr., deeds, Bloemfontein, 1912; ditto, Pretoria, 1928; ditto, Bloemfontein, Oct., 1928; regisr., deeds, Pretoria, 1933.

HAM, LAURENCE PETER VAN ZYL.—Ck., rly. and cent. tel. office, 1898; clk., res. mag., Hoopstad, June, 1902; A.R.M., Hoopstad, Aug., 1902; Jacobadal, Nov., 1903; Thaba 'Nchu, Feb., 1907; Winburg, Feb., 1910; D.A.R.M., Fouriesburg, Aug., 1911; Trompsburg, May, 1915; mag., Philippolis, Jan., 1918; Winburg, 1920; Wakkerstroom, May, 1920; ag. mag., Harrismith, Apr., 1925; inspr., pub. serv. comm., Feb., 1926; sec., ditto, Jan., 1928; sec., dept. of mines and industries, Sept., 1928.

HAMBLIN, R. A.—B. 1881; apptd. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil
ser. and temporarily employed in the science and art dept. from Mar. 21st to May 26th, 1899; assigned to C.O. July, 1899; conf. clk., 1st Jan., 1918; deptl. astt., 1st Apr., 1925.

HAMILTON, HON. ADAM.—B. 1880; ed. tech. schl., Dunedin, N.Z.; Knox Coll. and Otago Univ.; mem., N.Z. H. of R., 1919-22 and since 1925; P.M.G., min. of tels., min. of lab. since 1931; min., internal affrs., 1931-33; min., employment, 1933.

HAMILTON, ANDREW TODD.—B. 1879; astt. mast., educ. dept., Hong Kong, 1910; on mily. serv., Dec., 1917 to Feb., 1919; astt. mast., ols., II, Jan., 1920; astt. mast., 1921; cls., I, Mar., 1928; headmr., Ellis Kadodori schl. for Indians, Feb., 1929; senr. mast., 1933.

HAMILTON, ARCHIBALD JOHNSTON.—B. 1892; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1924; ent. service of govt. of Trinidad, Apr., 1911; mag., county of St. Patrick, Jan., 1927; do., St. George East, Jan., 1933.

HAMILTON, ERIC WILLIAM, B.A.—B. 1888; ed. Blundell's; exhtr., Slid. Suss. Coll., Camb., 1906; scholar, 1907; B.A., 1909; cadet, Hong Kong civ. ser., 1911; J.P., 1914; astt. sany. dept., 1915; astt. impts. and expts. office in addn., 1916; astt. to sany. dept. for sp. serv., 1918; dist. offr., 1918; dist. offr., South, 1920 and 1922; 2nd pol. mag., 1922 and 1923; pol. mag., Kowloon, 1924, 1928 and 1931; 2nd astt. col. sec., 1926; dep. elk. of couns. in addn., 1927; ag. 1st pol. mag., 1929; extra assist. col. sec., 1930; ag. P.M.G., 1931; ag. S.I.E., 1932.

HAMILTON, PERCIVAL JOHN ALEXANDER.—Col. audit dept., Aug., 1915; astt. audr., Nyassaland, Sept., 1915; audr., Br. Honduras, Aug., 1922; audr., Leeward Is., Dec., 1923; audr., Fiji, Br. Solomons Is. Prot., Gilbert & Ellice Is. Col., May, 1928; seconded to audit accounts of condominium govt., New Hebrides, Apr.-July, 1929; astt. audr., Hong Kong, 1932.

HAMILTON, Sir ROBERT WILLIAM, K.T., B.A.C.H. (1918).—Ed. at St. Paul's schl. and Trin. Hall, Camb.; class. scholar, B.A., 1889 (honours); M.A., 1892; student, Inner Temple, 1893; called to the bar, 1895; dist. commr., Lagos, 1895 to 1897; regir., E. Africa Prot., 1897; town mag., 1899; astt. judge and admistr.-gen., 1900; judge of high court of E. Africa, Aug., 1902; apptd. to serve on land comm., Oct., 1904; prin. judge, E. Africa Prot., Apr., 1906; chief justice, 1911; ret., 1920; partly under sec. of state for the cols., 3rd Sept., 1931; reassptd., 9th Nov., 1931; resigned, 1932.

HAMILYN, WILLIAM TEMPLE.—B. 1901; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1926; cadet, secretariat, Gambia, Jan., 1926; admstv. offr., 1928; ag. elk., exec. and leg. couns. and ag. inspr., schl. on various occasions; author of "A Short History of the Gambia."

HANCOCK, CYRIL GEORGE.—B. 1902; ed. Kingsland Grange, Shrewsbury, Bromsgrove Schl. and Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge; astt. dist. commr., Sierra Leone, Jan., 1925; dist. commr., Jan., 1931.

HANCOCK, Capt. Otho Lewis, O.B.E. (1926)—B. 1883; ed. King's Coll., Taunton and Exeter Coll., Oxford; 2nd lieut., Aug., 1914; lieut., 1914; capt., 1915; wounded, 1915; A.D.C. and priv. sec. to gov., Leeward Is., 1916; staff offr., local forces and adjutant, volunteers, Barbados, 1917; gov., H.M. prison, Barbados, 1920; ag. senr. pol. mag., Aug. to Sept., 1922; commr., Virgin Is., 1923; dir., prisons, Gold Coast, Aug., 1928; inspr., prisons, S. Stiltsm. and supt., Singapore prison, 1930; inspr., prisons, S. S. F.M.S., Jan., 1932.

HANCOCK, WILLIAM JOHN, M.I.E.E.—B. 1865; ed. Dublin and Glas. Univ.; G.S. & W. Rly. (Ireland within Inchicore); Electric Lighting and Telephone (Ireland); supt. of telephones, W. India, 1885; supt. of telegraphs, 1890; gov. electr. engr., 1894; mem. of senate, Univ. of Aust.; pres., W. Aust. Inst. of Eng., 1917-18; pres., Royal Soc. of W. Australia, 1918-19; hon. local soc., Inst. Elect. Engrs. (Lond.); lieut., A.A.M.C.; D.Sc., Univ. of W. India, 1924; Kelvin gold med., R. Socy. of W. India, 1924; hon. life mem., Inst. of Engrs. dian.

HANDS, ARTHUR L. C., M.B.E.—B. 1890; in p.o., St. Helena, Sept., 1896; 2nd astt. sec., 'off., Apr., 1898; regir. of births and deaths, 1904-07; oh. clk. and elk. to assr. sec., 1907; J.P., 1910; ag. crown prosecutor of the peace and pol. mag. during 1923.

HANDYSIDE, WILLIAM LUCAS, M.A.—B.Soc. Econ. (Lond.), F.R.G.S., F.R.S. (Lond.), B.1891; priseman, hons. English, Glasgow Univ., 1913; 1st place language, English hist., Glasgow Univ., 1914; astt. mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, July, 1915; mast. of method, Hong Kong Univ. (in addn.), 1918-20; astt. mast., II, Jan., 1920; lect., teachers' classes, Queen's Coll., 1917-20 and 1922-24; external exam. Hong Kong Univ., geography, history of China, 1922; head mast., Saiyingpun Schl., 1925; mast. of method (in addn.), Hong Kong Univ., Queen's Coll., 1927; lect. on ethics and logic, Hong Kong Univ., 1927; astt. mast., Queen's Coll., 1928; lect. on polit. science, 1928; lect. on hist. and statistics, 1929; headmast., Yuen Long schl., July, 1930; 2nd mast., Queen's Coll., lect., H.K. Univ., 1932-1933.

HANKY, LIEUT.-COL. STIR, M.P.A. (1919); K.C.B. (1916); C.B. (1912); R.F. Rugby; joined R.M.A., 1886; served H.M.S. "Ramillies," flagship and 2nd flot. Mediterranean, 1899-1901; naval intel. 1902-6; granted temporary rank of Maj. serving on a special comitee, 1906; served Mediterranean, 1907; astt. sec., comm. Imp. defence, 1908; apptd. sec., 1912; in cabinet, from 1916; British sec., Peace Com., 1919; comdr., Legion of Honour, 1917; ordnator, Crowns of Italy, 1918.

HANKINSON, WALTER CROSSLEY (1918).—B. 1894; ed. Manchester Gram. Sch., Jesus Coll., Oxford (exhibitioner); private Fussiliers, Sept., 1914; 2nd lieut., York Lancs. Regt., 9th Jan., 1915; lieut., 1915; capt., 13th May, 1915; served in France; demobilized, 28th Feb., 1919; under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cl. Feb., 1920; astt. prim., 1st Apr., 1920; sec. to Duke of Devonshire, 1st Mar., 1921; priv. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas, 1924 and to Mr. Amery, 26th Nov., 1925; priv. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas, 1924 and to Mr. Amery, 26th Nov., 1925; priv. sec. to Mr. J. H. Thomas, 1924 and to Mr. Amery, 26th Nov., 1925; rep. in Commonwealth of Australia of H.M.'s. govt. in U.K., 1931.

HANNAN, GERALD HUGH CRAWFORD.—Ed. Mercers' Schl., London; served in S.War, 1900-02 (2 meda, 5 clasps); 2nd astt. exec. and leg. couns., Transvaal, Oct., 1902; clk., olk., 1903; gentleman usher of his leg. couns., Transvaal, 1907; clk., astt. couns., Transvaal, 1910; elk. of prov. exec. comites, 1917.

HARDING, ALFRED J., C.M.G. (1927), O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1878; ed. Christ...
