WILLIAM CHARLES ABOEDOEHN VANNICK.—B. (Queensland) 1873; M.P., Eye divn., Suffolk, 1923-29; parly. pte. secy. to pres., B. of T., 1927-28; gov., Victoria, 1934.

HURST, RAYMOND GEORGE.—B. 1877; Indian State rlya., 1900; E. African rlya., 1917; asst. traffic supt., Tanganyika rlya., July, 1925.

HUSBAND, CHARLES THOMAS MAIN, F.S.I., F.R.G.S.—B. 1891; ed. Box Hill Grammar Schl., Melbourne; 1st grade survr., F.M.S., 1913; served France, 1915-18; asst. supt., surveys, F.M.S., Jan., 1919; ag. supt., Selangor, July-Nov., 1920; Perak, Feb., 1926; Johore, Sept., 1927; supt., surveys, F.M.S. & S.S., July, 1929.

HUSBAND, THOMAS GIBSON, B.Sc. (Edin.), A.M.I.C.E., Chartered Civil Engrnr.—B. 1890; ed. Heriot Watt Coll. and Edin. Univ.; asst. engrnr., Jasim, S.S., July, 1919; ag. exec. engrnr., Malacca, May, 1923; asst. engrnr., Penang, Dec., 1924; ditto, P. Wellesley, Jan., 1927; exec. engrnr., South, P. Wellesley, Apr., 1929; engr. exec. engrnr., P.W.D., June, 1931; ditto, rural and marine, S'pore, July, 1931; senr. exec. engrnr., wks. and bldgs., K. Lumpur, Oct., 1932.

HUSSEY, ERIC ROBERT JAMES, C.M.G. (1933).—B. 1885; ed., Repton (Schl.), open exhibn., Hertford Coll., Oxford, 1904; B.A., 1908 (lit. hum.), M.A., 1923; Sudan civ. serv. as tutor, Gordon Coll., Khartum, Sept., 1908; dist. commr., 1912; ch. inspr., educn. dept., 1918; educn. mission to Somaliland, 1920; educn. mission to Uganda, 1924; dir., educn., Uganda, 1925; educn. mission to Kenya, 1928; dir., educn., Nigeria, 1929; mem., stat. commn. of inspcecn., Prince of Wales Coll., Achimota, 1932.

HUSSBY, THOMAS MACDONALD.—B. 1888; ed. Long Ashton Coll., Somerset; offl. censor, cinematograph films, S.S., F.M.S. and Johore, Dec., 1919.

HUTCHINGS, HUGH H., I.S.O. (1930)—Inspr. of govt. schls., Turks and Caicos Is., 1898-1906; J.P., 1901; ch. offr., fire brigade, 1901-19; clk. to commr. and inspr. of schls., 1907; asst. commr., Grand Turk, 1908-19; ag. audr., 1908-13; audr., 1913-19; ag. commr. and ag. judge of sup. ct., five occasions, 1911-19; ag. commr. of Cayman Is., 1912-13; commr., Cayman Is., June, 1919; commr., Montserrat, Sept., 1929; ret., Sept., 1931; ag. commr., Turks and Caicos Is., July, 1933.

HUTCHINS, ERNEST ELWYN.—B. 1886; ed. Exeter Schl.; forestry course, Edinburgh Univ., 1903-04; forest dept., S. Africa, 1904; forest demarcator, Kenya, 1909; asst. conservator, forests, Kenya, 1911; E. Africa Mounted Rifles, 1915-16; asst. polit. offr., German E. Africa, 1916-21; admn. offr., 1st grade (now dist. offr.), Tanganyika Territory, 1921.

HUTCHINSON, GEORGE STUART MENTETH.—B. 1883; ed. United Services Coll., Westward Ho! and Royal Milv. Coll., Sandhurst; 2nd lieut., unattd. list, 1902; Indian Army, 1903; capt., 1911; major, 1917; Burma Milv. Pol., Southern Shan States, 1910-14; Indian Exped. Force, France, 1915; ment. in despatches, 1915; invalided, 1917; examining offr., Miny. of Pensions, 1917; regional wounds offr. for Scotland, 1919; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, asst. prin., C.O., 1st Apr., 1924; prin., 1st, 1st Oct., 1930.

HUTCHISON, DONALD MAXWELL WRIGHT, B.Sc. (Eng.), M.I.C.E., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1882; ed. Wellington Coll. and Faraday House; asst. elec. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S.; B. inspr., electy. encl., F.M.S., 1915; engrnr., electl. bd., P.W.D., Jan., 1923; engrnr. and inspr., electl. dept., F.M.S., 1928; ag. dir., elec. dept., June to Dec., 1930; apr., 1931.

HUTSON, SIR EYRE, K.C.M.G. (1922), (1911), B.A.—B. 1864; 2nd clk. to gov. Lee Oct., 1885; asst. priv. sec. to gov. Barbados, 1885; priv. sec. to gov. Barbados, Mar., 1886 at Mauritius, Jan., 1890; at Br. Guiana, July, 1894; chmn., schools commn., 1902; St. George's harbour commn., 1903; col. July, 1908; chmn., educn. commn., ap. rep. Fiji and W. Pacific high commn., tel. conf., Melbourne, Dec., 1909; dep. various occasions, 1909-12; commn., apr., Dec., 1914; ag. gov. Fiji and high commn., Pacific, Aug., 1915 to May, 1916 and from Oct., 1918; gov., B. Honduras, Nov., 1925; Fiji and high commn., W. Pacific, 1925; July, 1929.

HUTT, ALEXANDER MCDONALD BURTON.—B. 1904; ed. St. Andrew's Coll., Grahamstown; Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. (Eagle cadet), Tanganyika Territory, Jan., 1926; dist. offr., Jan., 1928; ag. dist. offr., 1932.

HUTTON-MILLS, ALEXANDER, B.A.—L. ed. Dulwich and Keble Coll., Oxford; juridprudence; called to bar, Middle Temp., 1924; practised in Gold Coast, 1924-30; Gold Coast, 1930.

HUXHAM, HAROLD JAMES.—Commr., tax, Ceylon, Apr., 1932.

HYAMSON, ALBERT MONTFORD.—(1931), F.R.Hist.S.—B.1875; ed. Oxford Uni. and Swansea Gram. Schl.; savings bank, G.P.O., London, 1895-98; supplement, assy., dept., G.P.O., 1898 to Jan., 1927; infmr., F.O., Dec., 1917 to Mar., 1918; infmr., miny. of infrm., Apr., to Nov., 1919; mission, Nov., 1918 to Mar., 1919; immigrn. and travel, Palestine, Jan., contrlr., lab., Dec., 1921; in charge of immigrn. and travel, Dec., 1923 to Mar., contrlr., permits, Apr., 1924; ch. inspr., Oct., 1926; sec., cent. town planning Sept., 1922; mem., economy comm., comte, on rates of wages for govt. emp., dep. chmn., lab., standing comm., immigrn., Jan., 1932; author, "A History of the Jews in England," "The Rebirth of an Ancient People," "Old and New," "British Project Restoration of the Jews," etc.

HYDE, ANTHONY, M.A., Barrister-at-Law, 1900; ed. Westminster Schl. and Christ Church, Oxford (exhibt.); called to bar, Inn, 1925; cadet, S.S., Dec., 1924; attd. to Alor Gajah, Malacca, 1925; priv. sec., 1929; seconded to C.O. as asst. prin., Oct., 1930.

IMBERT, A. E.—Labour inspection, East Africa Prot., June, 1919; ch. regtr., Kenya, Jan., 1925.

INGHAM, RAYWOOD, B.A. (Oxon.), Eagle cadet, S.S., Dec., 1912; attd. to monger, Jan., 1913; pol. mag., Malacca (in ad. 1915; collr. war tax, Malacca (in ad. 1917; collr. war tax, Singapore, Nov., 1917; offr., cls. INGLEDOW, Cedric Francis.—B. 1894; on mly. serv., Mar., 1915; cadet, Ceylon, Aug., 1920; attld. to Kurunegala kach., Sept., 1920; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., N.W. INGRAMS, William Harold, O.B.E.(1933).—B. 1897; ed. Shrewsbury; served K.S.L.I., Sept., 1914 to May, 1919; wounded, Belgium, May, 1916; employed, directorate of recruiting, W.O., Dec., 1916; min. of nat. serv., Dec., 1917; min. of lab., demob. and resettlement dept., Nov., 1918; F.Z.S., May, 1919; asst. dist. comsrr., Zanzibar, July, 1919; F.R.A.I., 1921; F.R.G.S., 1922; M.R.A.S., 1923; mem., Société d'Anthropologie de Paris, 1923; certif., acad. of internat. law, Hague, 1924; higher standard, Swahili, 1923; 2nd asst. sec., Jan., 1925; prte. sec. to ag. high comsrr., Apr. to June, 1925; ditto to Br. res., Nov., 1925 to Aug., 1926 and from Oct. to Nov., 1926; ag. pte. sec. to H.H. the Sultan, Nov., 1925 to June, 1926; clk. prot. coun., Feb. to June, 1925; edr., Offl. Gaz., in 1924, 1925 and 1927; clk., exec. and leg. couns., Aug. to Oct., 1926 and Mar. to July, 1927; mem. Pemba educn. comttee. and teaching of Koran comsrr., 1924; mem. museum comttee., 1924 and ag. chmn., Aug., 1926; cls. IV., Order of Brilliant Star, Zanzibar, 1927; asst. col. sec., Mauritius, 1927; chmn., museum reorganisation comttee., 1928; chmn., comsrr. of enquiry, med. and health dept., 1928; mem. schls. comttee., 1928-29; vice pres., bd. of dirs., Mauritius Inst., 1929; mem., R. Coll., comttee., 1929-31; ag. ast. prin., C.O., 1929-30; ag. recr. gen., June-July, 1932; ag. col. sec., Jan.-May, and from Aug., 1932; part author, "Zanzibar; an account of its People, Industries and History" (1924), "Sch. History of Zanzibar" (1925), and "Aya Za Kuraani" (1926); author "Dialects of Zanzibar Sultanate" (1924), "Chronology and Genealogies of Zanzibar Rulers" (1926), "Guide to Swahili Examinations" (1927), "Zanzibar, Its History and People" (1931), "School History of Mauritius" (1931), "School Geography of Mauritius" (1932), and various pamphlets and articles.

INNES, Cameron Star.—B. 1892; Imp. serv., male learner, post office, 1908; seconded col. serv., 1921; war serv., 1914-19; ent. Nigeria serv., as ast. survr., posts and tels., Mar., 1921; divnl. survr., Apr., 1933.

INNES, Rt. Hon., Sir James Rose, P.C.(1915), K.C.M.G.(1901), K.C.—B. 1855; called to the bar of sup. ct., Cape Colony, Feb., 1878; mem. for Victoria East house of assem., Cape, 1884; subsequently reprtd. Cape div.; atty.-gen., 1st Rhodes' ministry, July, 1890, to May, 1893; selected by Imp. govt. to watch proceedings in connection with trial of reform comttee. prisoners at Pretoria, 1896; atty.-gen. 4th Sprigg ministry, 1900-2; deleg. for Cape Colony to attend conf. in Lond. on final ct. of appeal, 1901; ch. just. sup. ct., Transvaal, Mar., 1902; ordinary judge of appeal, sup. ct., Union of S. Africa, 1910; ch. just. of S. Africa, Oct., 1914; ret., Mar., 1927.

INNESS, William James Deacon, C.M.G. (1929), M.R.C.S.(Eng.), L.R.C.P.(Lond.), D.P.H. (Ireland).—B. 1877; ed. Exeter Sch. and St. Mary's Hosp., Lond.; house physician, Bethlem Royal Hosp.; med. offr., N. Nigeria, 1905; senr. sanv. offr., Nigeria, 1914; ast. dir. of med. serv., Nigeria, 1921; dir., med. and sanv. services, Sierra Leone, 1924; dir., med. and sanv. serv., Gold Coast, Mar., 1927; mem., exec. and leg. couns.

INNISS, Knollys Ulric Alexander, M.B., Ch. B. Edin.—B. 1882; entd. med. serv., Trinidad, Aug., 1904; dist. med. offr., Aug., 1912.

INSKIPP, Percy Sidney, O.B.E.(Mily.).—Cik., admnstr.'s off., S. Rhodesia, 1891; ag. sec., 1892; sec. to admnstr., 1893; under sec., 1897; joined London staff, B.S.A. Co., 1900; dir., B.S.A. Co., Apr., 1919; gen. man., B.S.A. Co., S. Africa, June, 1922; mem. of pioneer corps (occupation of Mashonaland), 1890; also served with the Mashonaland horse, Matabele rebellion, 1896 (medal), and Rhodesia field force, 1900 (medal and 2 clasps); joined R.A.S.C., 1914; O.C., R.A.S.C., Harwich dist., 1914-17; S.S.O., 48th divn., France, Flanders, Italy, 1917-19; Croce di Guerra, Italy; ment. in despatches.

IRBY, G. N.—B. 1889; ed. Eton and Balliol Coll., Oxford; 2nd lieut., Oxford and Bucks. L.I., May, 1915; invalided with rank of capt., Jan., 1918; ast. priv. sec. (apptmts.) to Lord Milner, July, 1920; to Mr. Churchill, Feb., 1921; the Duke of Devonshire, Oct., 1922; Mr. J. H. Thomas, Jan., 1924; Mr. L. C. M. S. Amery, Nov., 1924; prin., 1st Oct., 1930.

IRELAND, Frederick Joseph.—B. 1903; apptd., after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 30th Sept., 1920.

IRVINE, Frederick Robert, M.Sc. Ag., Fellow Linnean Soc.(1927).—B. 1898; ed. Royal Grammar Sch., Newcastle-on-Tyne; war serv., Gordon Highlanders, France and Belgium, 1916-19; 2nd lieut., R.A.F., 1918; R.Sc., agr., Armstrong Coll., Durham Univ., 1920; teacher of agr. and biology, Achimota, Gold Coast, 1924.

IRVINE, Robert, M.C.(1917).—B. 1894; ed. Dunfermline High Schl.; bd. of agr., Scotland, 1913; served in France, 1915-18; capt., Lancs. Fusiliers, 1918; cadet, F.M.S., Oct., 1919; pvte. sec. to ch. sec. to gov't., Mar., 1921; offr. cls. V., July, 1921; ast. dist. offr., Tampin, Apr., 1922; ag. 2nd mag., K. Lumpur, May, 1923; dist. offr., Jelube, Nov., 1924; ast. dist. offr., Lower Perak, Jan., 1925; offr., cls. IV., July, 1925; ag. 2nd ast. sec. (A) S.S., May, 1926; ag. 1st ast. sec. (B) S.S. and clk. of couns., Mar., 1928; dist. offr., Tampin, Dec., 1929; offr., cls. III., July, 1930.

IRVINE, Hon. Sir Wm. Hill, K.C.M.G.(1914), LL.D., K.C.—B. 1858; called to the bar, Victoria, 1884; premier of Victoria, 1902-4; mem. H. of R., C. of A., since 1906; atty.-gen., C. of A., June, 1913 to Sept. 1914; chief just., Victoria, Apl., 1918; lieut.-gov., Victoria, May, 1918; ag. gov. from June, 1931.

IRVING, Francois Ernest.—B. 1885; ed. at St. Andrew's Coll. and Marist Bros. Schl., S. Africa; served in Boer War, 1901-2; German S.W. Africa, with Imp. Light Horse, 1914-15; German E. Africa, 1916; seconded to admnstr. of Mafia Is., as finan. offr., Nov., 1916, to May, 1919; ast. cust. dept., Zanzibar, Oct., 1919; ag. ast. compt., cust. for various periods, 1920-22; ast. compt., cust., Dec., 1922; ag. compt., cust. for various periods, 1924-33.

IRVING, Hugh Craufurd.—Ast. dist. comsrr., Somaliland Prot., June, 1914.

IRWIN, 1st Baron (cr. 1925), Hon. Edward Frederick Lindley Wood.—B. 1881; ed. Eton
and Christ Church and All Souls, Oxford (M.A. and fellow); major, Yorkshire Dragoons; M.P., Ripon divn., Yorks, 1910-25; under sec. of state for the cols., Apr., 1921; min. of educn., Oct., 1922; viceroy of India, 1926.

IRWIN, HENRY MARK, B.A.—B. 1885; ed. Haileybury and Selwyn Coll.; Cambridge exhibitioner; Haileybury exhibitioner; hons. class. tripos, 1908; ast. res., N. Nigeria, 1908; attached to secretariat, July to Dec., 1911; priv. sec. to ag. gov., C. L. Temple, Esq., C.M.G., June, 1912.

IRWIN, ROBERT EDWARD.—B. 1899; ed. at Christ's Hosp.; col. audit dept., Oct., 1925; ast. audr., Tanganyika Territory, Nov., 1925; ast. audr., Gold Coast, Dec., 1928.

ISAACS, Rt. Hon. Sir ISAAC ALFRED, P.C. (1921), G.C.M.G. (1932), K.C.M.G. (1928).—B. 1855; called to the bar, Victoria, 1880; Q.C., 1899; M.L.A., Victoria, 1892-1901; solr.-gen., 1893; atty.-gen., 1894-9; and again in 1900; mem. of Aust. Fed. Convention, 1897-8; and of first Federal parlimt.; atty.-gen. in Deakin ministry, 1905-6; judge of High Ct. of Australia, Oct., 1906; ag. ch. just., 1925 and 1927; ch. just., Mar., 1930; gov. gen. of the C'wealth of Australia, Jan., 1931.

ISAACS, FRANK NOEL.—B. 1871; Jamaica civ. serv., 1890; held appts. in various depts., 1891-1907; clk. of wks. and acctnt., new pub. bldg., 1909; sec., bd. of supervision, 1910; sec., malaria comrn., 1910-12; exec. offr., malaria comrn., 1910-12; drought and hurricane relief offr., 1912-17; ag. prot., immigrtn., 1914; man., Rio Cobre home, 1917; comanr., parish of St. Catharine, 1921; sec., child welfare coman., 1921.

ISHERWOOD, ALBERT ARTHUR MANGNALL, O.B.E. (1928), M.A. (Oxon).—B. 1889; ed. St. John's schl., Leatherhead, and University Coll., Oxford; jnr. supt., educn. dept., N. Nigeria, July, 1913; loaned to polit. dept., N. Nigeria, 1915-17; polit. offr., Tanganyika adminstr., 8th Oct., 1917; ag. senr. comanr., Feb., 1923 to Jan., 1924; dep. dir., educn., Sept., 1924; ag. dir., educn., Oct., 1924 to Mar., 1925; ditto and mem., exec. coun., in 1927, 1929, 1931 and 1932; Swahili examr.; mem., exec. and leg. coun., Aug., 1929 to Feb., 1930; dir., educn., 1933.

ISLINGTON, 1ST BARON (cr. 1910), KT. HON. SIR JOHN POYNDER DICKSON-POYNDER, 6TH BART., P.C. (1911); G.C.M.G. (1913); K.C.M.G. (1911); D.S.O. (1900); J.P.—B. 1806; ed. at Harrow and Christ Church, Oxford; major and hon. col., Wilts Yeomanry; served in S. Africa, 1900 (Queen's medal, 3 clasps); late lieut., 3rd Royal Scots; mem. L.C.C., 1898-1904; M.P., Chippenham, Wilts, 1892-1910; gov., New Zealand, 1910-1912; chmn. of Indian civ. ser. coman., 1912; partly, under sec. of state for the colonies, 1914; partly, under sec. for India, 1915.

IVES, WILLIAM CARLOS, B.C.L.—B. 1873; ed. pub. schl., Pincher Creek, Alta., Coaticook, Queb., and McGill Univ.; puisne judge, sup. ct., Alta., 1914.

IVEY, Lieut. Commdr. A. V. P., R.D., R.N.R.—B. 1894; Royal Navy, 1915; sub. lieut., R.N.R., 1917; lieut. commdr., 1927; Cameroons expedy. force, 1915-16; Harwich force destroyers, 1916-17; commanded Torpedo boats, 1918; commanded H.M. river gunboat "Robin" on West River, China, 1919; marine offr., Nigeria, 1920; harb. mast., Port Harcourt, 1926; prin. marine offr., 1930.

IZARD, GODFREY WALLACE.—B. 1891; ed. Uppingham; B.S.A. Co., 1904-14; called to bar, Middle Temple, June, 1914; enlisted, Aug., 1914; invalided; admstive offr., Nigeria, Jan., 1915; admstive serv., Apr., 1930; dep. corzn., lands, 1930; prin. astt. sec., N. Prova., 1931.

IZARD, H.—Ast. dist. comanr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915.

JACK, HENRY WALTER, M.B.E. (1930), D.Sc., B.A.—B. 1891; ed. Univ. Coll., Cork (scholar); B.A. (econ.), 1911; B.Sc. (biol.), 1912; agr. instr., F.M.S., 1914; agr. instr., 1915; cc. botanist, S.S. & F.M.S., 1919; mem., comtece. on rubber research, 1923; D.S.O. by research, 1923; rep. of Malaya, Pac. Sc. Cong., Japan, 1926 and in Java, 1929; economic botanist, Mar., 1929; mem., coconut and oil palm research comtece., 1929; hon. sec., rice cult. comtece., Malaya, 1929; pubslns. on rice, coconuts, oil palm, cotton, rubber, etc.

JACK, MURRAY M.—B. 1893; ed. Peterhead Acad. and Aberdeen Univ.; solr., sup. ct. Scotland, 1920; H.B.M. consul. cts., Egypt, 1922-25; war serv., Gordon Highlanders and I.A.R.O., 1914-19 (capt., ment. in despatches); dep. regar., eq. ot., Kenya, 1925; ast. admstr. gen. and off. recvr., Tanganyika Territory 1926; regar., eq. ot., Kenya and E.A. ct. of appl., July, 1929; rep. and coll., E. A. Law Repta., 1930-32.

JACKLIN, S., M.C.—Ast. compt., regar. dept., Christiana, Aug., 1902; rev. clk., law dept., Nov., 1902; clk., civ. oomn. off., Pretoria, Nov., 1903; clk., rev. dept., Mar., 1905; prin. clk., Oct., 1906; prin. clk., inland rev. dept., Apr., 1912; inspr., inland rev. dept., Nov., 1916; surv., inland rev. dept., Apr., 1918; ag. dep. comanr., Johannesburg, Sept., 1919; ch. clk., establs. treasur., Union of S. Africa, Jan., 1920; sec. pub. ser. oomn., Oct., 1921; ret., Oct., 1926; treas., League of Nations, Oct., 1926.

JACKS, PHILIP.—B. 1877; ed. Plymouth Coll.; admtd. solr., sup. ct., England, 1906; ast. land offr., Hong Kong, 1905; J.P., 1916; comanr. for oaths, 1905; ag. land offr., 1907 to 1908; ag. land offr. and offr. recvr. in bankrupcy, 1908; ag. land offr., 1911; and from 1913-14; land offr., 1916; ag. crown solr., 1919 and 1920; called to the bar (Inner Temp.), 1922; regar., marriages in admn., 1927; ag. pu. judge on several occasions, 1927-33.

JACKSON, SIR EDWARD ST. JORNS. K.T. BACH. (1933), O.B.E. (1918), K.C.—Ed. Steinhurst and Beaumont Colleges and Brasenose College, Oxford; B.A., 1908; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1910; legal adviser, Garra, Oct., 1912; atty.-gen., Nyasaland, Oct., 1913; judge of high ct., July, 1920; pres. of land comanr., 1920; pres., finance comanr., 1922; atty.-gen., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1924; atty.-gen., Ceylon, May, 1929.

JACKSON, MAJOR FRANCIS WALTER FITZGERALD, C.M.G. (1928), D.S.O. (1917).—B. 1881; ed. Dover Coll.; entd. R.A., 1899; served in S. Africa, 1901-2; seconded to W.A.F.F., Feb., 1904; dist. comanr., Northern Territories, G. Coast, 1st Jan., 1907; astt. col. sec., G. C. 10th Mar., 1911; provincial comanr., G. C. 23rd Jan., 1915; services lent to W.O. Mar., 1915, to Apr., 1919; served in France, May, 1915 to June, 1918; ment. in desps. 3 times; off. British forces, and senr. polit. offr., Togoland, July, 1919; represented govt., in final transfer over of Lome and that portion of Togoland east to France by the Franco-British declaration of July, 1919; dep. ch. comanr., Ashanti, 1927.
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

JACKSON, GILDART.—B. 1901; ed. Edgeborough Sch., Guildford and Westminster; ast. dist. comsnr., Sierra Leone, 12th Nov., 1924.

JACKSON, ROBERT BEST, M.B., D.P.H., B.A.O., M.D., T.C.D., L.M. Rotunda Hospital, Dublin, certif., London Sch., Trop. Med.; R.A.M.C., 1914-17; med. offr., F.M.S., Nov., 1920; health offr., Negri Sembilan, 1921-1922; do., Pahang West, 1926; malariologist, med. dept., Hong Kong, 1930.

JACKSON, SIR WILFRED EDWARD FRANCIS, K.C.M.G. (1931), C.M.G.—B. 1883; ed. Stonyhurst Coll. and Lincoln Coll., Oxford (classical scholar), B.A. 1905; personal sec. to gov., Trinidad, 1906; priv. sec. to gov. and elk. to exec. coun., Bahamas, Sept., 1906, to Oct., 1907; ast. collr., Uganda, Nov., 1907; ag. dist. comsnr., Toro, July, 1911 to Apr., 1912; dist. comsnr., Apr., 1912; ag. ast. chief sec., July-Dec., 1912; 1st ast. sec., Dec., 1912; ag. ast. chief sec., Aug., 1913 to Feb., 1914, May to Nov., 1914 and from Apr., 1915; col. sec., Bermuda, 19th Feb., 1916; col. sec., Barbados, 1921; col. sec., Trinidad, Feb., 1926; ag. gov., Apr. to Nov., 1927; col. sec., Gold Coast, 1929; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Mauritius, Mar., 1930.

JACOBS, CHARLES ERNEST HARVEY (late R.A.), B.Sc. (Chem.), B.Sc. (Bot.) Vict., L.C.P. Diploma in Edcn.—B. 1886; ed. Brewood Gram. Sch., Staffordshire and Victoria Univ. (Queen's Coll.), Manch.; ast. master, Marlborough Coll., Cranleigh Sch., and Reading Sch.; sr. sc. master, Raffles Inst., S'pore, Feb., 1921; sr. normal instr., in addn., Apr., 1929; sr. master, Raffles Inst., Nov., 1930; headmast., High Sch., B. Mertajam, Aug., 1931.

JACQUES, EVYNN BESSIE, M.B., Ch.B. (Bristol), D.T.M. & H. (Lond.).—Lady med. offr., Seremban, F.M.S., Feb., 1921; do., K. Lumpur, Feb., 1922; do., Ipoh, Apr., 1924; do., Taiping, June, 1926.

JACQUES, FREDERICK VIEL, M.B., Ch.B. (Bristol), D.P.H. (Lond.), D.T.M. & H. (Eng.),—B. 1891; ed. Gresham's Sch., Bristol Univ. and Lond. Hosp.; midshipman and sub. lieut., R.N.V.R., 1909-15; surg. sub. lieut., 1916; North Sea, 1914-15; E. Mediterranean, 1916-17; med. offr., Malayan med. serv. (Seremban), 1921; health offr., K. Lumpur, 1922; Kinta, 1924; Perak North, 1926; lieut., M.S.V.R., 1927; ag. sen. health offr., Perak, 1928 and 1931; ag. dep. state med. and health offr., Perak, 1932.

JAMES, HERBERT BARIL.—Ed. Jesus Coll., Oxford (exhibitioner), 2nd class math. mods., 1908; 3rd class final honour schl. nat. science, 1910; ast. res., Northern Nigeria, 30th Nov., 1910; res., Dec., 1926.

JAMES, JOSEPH EDWARD, M.B.E. (1930).—B. 1867; ed. at pub. schls. and Mico Coll., Antigua; ag. educn-offr., Antigua, Nov., 1901; clkr., educn. dept. and educn. offr., Antigua, Apr., 1904; schlmast., St. John's Training Schl., Antigua, Feb., 1913, to June, 1917; sub-inspr. schls., Antigua, Apr., 1914; sub-inspr., schls., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1919; local inspr., schla., Mar., 1927; ag. fedl. inspr., schla., July, 1928 to Jan., 1929.

JAMES, MARSHALL NICOL.—B. 1875; served under the condominium govt., New Hebrides until Mar., 1922; govt. agt., New Hebrides, Mar., 1922.

JAMES, S. I.—B. 1891; ed. St. Paul's Schl.; on mily. serv., Sept., 1914 to Aug., 1919; ent. W.O. (temp.) Nov., 1919; ent. O.O. as clerical offr., July, 1926; ag. cler. offr., higher grade, 10th Mar., 1931; ast. prin., 1st Oct., 1932.

JAMES, SIR WALTER HARTWELL, K.T. BACH. (1907).—Ed. in Perth at state and high schls., admitted as barrister and solicitor, 1888; member for East Perth, 1894; represented W. Aust. at fed. conven., 1897-8; hon. minister, 1901; K.C., 1902; premier and atty.-gen., 1902; agt. gen. for W.A., 1904-1906; chan., univ. of W. Australia.

JAMISON, ROBERT, M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O. (Ireland), F.R.C.S. (Eng.), D.T.M. (Lond.).—B. 1880; ast. med. offr., Hatikulu, Swaziland, 1910-13; med. offr., Swaziland, 1913; served, S.W. Africa campaign, 1914-15; prin. med. offr., 1918

JANSSEN, HON. ERNEST GEORGE, B.A., LL.B., M.P.—B. 1881; ed. Ladysmith Govt. Schl. and Durban High Schl.; leader of Nationalist party in Natal; mem., Natal Univ. Coll. Coun.; chmn., Saamwerk Unie van Natalse Vereeniginge (the first body in S.A. to prescribe exams in Afrikaans) for 7 years; foundation mem. of Suid Afrikaanse Akademie vir Taal, lettere en kuns; mem., Union H. of A. for Vryheid since 1921; speaker, Union H. of A., July, 1924-July, 1929; min. of native affrs., June, 1929 to Mar., 1933; speaker, H. of A., May, 1933.

JANSZ, HERBERT ERIC.—B. 1890; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. serv., Sept., 1914; att. Kandy kach., Sept., 1914; att., Batticaloa kach., Dec., 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Batticaloa, in addl. Aug., 1915; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Batticaloa, Sept., 1915; office asst. to ast. govt. agt., Kegalla, Jan., 1917; office asst. to govt. agt., N. Prov., Jan. 1918; pol. mag., Kalutara, Mar., 1920; dist. judge, Ratnapura, Jan., 1923; addnl. dist. judge, Avisawella, in addn., Oct., 1927; ast. stlitmt. offr., Sept., 1928; ag. pol. mag., Colombo, Apr. to June, 1930; ag. stlitmt. offr., Mar., 1931.

JANSZ, REGINALD BELTRAN.—B. 1878; cls. V Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1928; office ast. to ast. govt. agt., Trincomalee, Nov. 1928.

JARDINE, DOUGLAS JAMES, C.M.G. (1932), O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1888; ed. at Westminster and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; 2nd cls. classical trip., 1910; B.A., 1910; M.A., 1914; chief sec.'s off., Cyprus, 1910; pvt. sec. to ag. high comsnr., July to Oct., 1911; ast. sec. to govt., 1912; ag. ch. ast. sec. on several occasions, 1912-16; passed in modern Greek, 1912; sec. to the adminstr., Somaliland, 1916; accompanied mission to Abyssinia on occasion of coronation of the Empress Zauditu (3rd cls. Star of Ethiopia), 1917; in charge H.Q. services, Somaliland Expedy. Force, 1920 (A.G.S. med. and ment. in desp.); senr. ast. sec., Nigerian secretariat, 1921; ag. dep. ch. sec., July to Nov., 1925 and June to Aug., 1926; dep. ch. sec., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1927; ag. ch. sec., June to Nov., 1927 and Apr. to Oct., 1928; ch. sec., Jan., 1929; gov.'s dep. on several occasions since 1927; ag. gov., in 1929, 1931 and 1933; gov., North Borneo, 1933; accredited rep. to Perm. Mandates Coman., 1929, 1930 and 1931; joint-editor "Hand-book of Cyprus," 1913 and 1919, and author of "Mad Mullah of Somaliland," 1923.

JARDINE, ROBERT FRIER, C.M.G. (1928), O.B.E. (1926).—B. 1894; ed. Downing Coll., Cambridge; served European War in Gallipoli, Egypt and Mesopotamia; polit. offr., Mesopotamia, 1917 ast. divnl. adviser, Mosul prov., under Iraq govt., 1921; admstve. inspr., Mosul prov., 1923; on sp. duty in Europe in connec. with Mosul question, 1925; admstve. inspr., Sulaimani, 1925; do., Mosul prov., 1925; ditto, Basra, 1928;
author "Grammar of Behdinan Kurmanji (Kurdish)," 1922.

JARRETT, JAMES HENRY.—B. 1895; ed. Lancing Coll.; barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn; H.A.C., 1914; served European War, 1914-19; asst. dist. commr., Uganda, 1919; seconded, judi. dept. as mag., 1922; mag., 1924; asst. atty.-gen., 1926; ag. solr. gen., May, 1927 to Jan., 1928; crown coun., 1927; atty.-gen., Grenada, 1929; ag. admstr. and ag. ch. just., St. Vincent in 1930 and 1931; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1933.

JARRETT, NORMAN ROWSTONE.—B. 1889; ed. Highgate and Exeter Coll., Oxford, 3rd cl. class. mods., 1910, 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1912; B.A., 1912; cadet, F.M.S., 1912; passed cadet, July, 1914; offr., cls. V, Feb., 1916; cls. IV, Jan., 1920; dist. offr., Mar., 1921; offr., cls. III, Jan., 1925; offr., cls. II, 1930; asst. sec. to gov't., F.M.S., Apr., 1930; ag. sec. to res., Perak, May, 1931; ag. Br. advr., Trengganu, June, 1933.

JARVIS, CYRIL CHESTER.—B. 1884; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; Rhodes schol., 1904; Wadham Coll., Oxford, B.A. (hon. juris.); LL.B., Cape Univ.; sec., ch. just., Cape Colony, 1907; admitted Cape bar, 1910; ch. olk. to atty.-gen., O.F.S.; prof. asst. to atty.-gen., Cape Prov., 1921; crown pros., Johannesburg, 1928; atty.-gen., Natal, 1933.

JAYATNE, MERENNA FRANCIS DE SILVA, B.A. (Lond.).—B. 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Feb., 1927; attd. Colombo kach., Mar., 1927; office asst., Matala kach., Jan., 1928; pol. mag., Jaffna, Mar., 1930; office asst., Batticaloa kach., Mar., 1933.

JEFF, CAPT. JOHN.—B. 1896; ed. Glasgow Univ.; cadet, F.M.S., attd. Chinese prov., Ipoh, Apr., 1920; passed cadet, Dec., 1922; asst. prot., Chinese, Seremban, Dec., 1923; attd., cust. dept., Jan., 1925; offr., cls. IV., 1927; ag. prot., Chinese, Perak, Apr., 1928; ditto, N. Sembilan, Jan., 1930; ditto, Selangor and Pahang, May, 1931; offr., cls. III., Apr., 1932; ag. asst. sec., Chinese affs., S.S., Aug., 1933.

JEFF, RICHARD HERDLEY ALLISON.—B. 1889; jr. asst. engr., F.M.S. Rlys., June, 1913; dist. engr., grade III, head office, July, 1915; superm. dist. engr., July, 1919; on sp. duty in S. India, Aug., 1919; dist. engr., grade II, K. Lumpur, Jan., 1920; dist. engr., grade I, Jan., 1924; ag. sec. to gen. man., F.M.S. Rlys., June, 1928-Aug., 1929; sr. dist. engr., head office, June, 1929; ditto, Johore Bahru, Feb., 1931; divn. engr., F.M.S. rlys., Aug., 1932.

JEFFERY, GEORGE, O.B.E. (1924), F.S.A.—Scholarship, R. Coll. of Art and Science, 1872; scholarship in architecture, R. Academy of London (1874); F.R.I.B.A., 1892; architect to Rt. Rev. Bishop in Jerusalem and the East, 1892; hon. corres. mem. of Imperial Institute of Archæology of Russia, 1897; local sec. for Cyprus Society of Antiquaries; inspr. of pub. wks., Cyprus, 1898; curator of ancient monuments, Cyprus, 1903; relinquished appt. July, 1919; reapptd. curator of ancient monuments, Cyprus, Feb., 1921; author of "Summary of Architectural Monuments of Cyprus," "Cyprus under an English King," "Historic Monuments of Cyprus," and of several papers on the medieval archæology of Cyprus and Jerusalem, edr., new edition (1929) of "An attempt at a Bibliography of Cyprus."

JEFFREY, PAT COMMR., A., R.D., R.N.R.—B. 1892; ed. Glas. Univ.; R.N., 1914-19; probationer, N. Rhodesia, 1919; J.P., 1920; clk. of ct. and under-sheriff, Bataka dist., 1920; asst. nat. commr., 1921; nat. commr., passed higher Chinyanga; asst. dir. Tanganyika Territory 1927; asst. sec., Jan., 1930.

JEFFREYS, ROBERT SYDNEY.—B. 1890; Cape Town (S. Africa), Bedford Schol., John's Coll., Cambridge, B.A., LL.B.; Barrister-at-Law (Gray's Inn, 1910); admstr. of N. Rhodesia, June, 1914; nat. commr., and J.P., July, 1916; resigned from active serv., Feb., 1918; rejoined N. E. admstr., May, 1919; native commr., July, 1920; seconded to secretariat, Nov., 1921; Dist. commr., Apr., 1926; dist. offr. (grade II), powers of mag., Apr., 1929; seconded as nat. sec. for native affs., Mar., 1927-Oct., 1929; crown coun., Nov., 1928-Mar., 1929; ag. mag., May, 1930.

JEFFRIES, CHARLES J., O.B.E. (1896); ed. Malvern Coll.; class. deny., Magd. Coll., Oxford, 1912; 2nd lieut., 3rd Wiltshire Regt., Sept., 1915; served in France, 1915-1917; invalided from army, Nov., 1917; 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 27th Dec., 1917; appointed reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., 1919; sec., E. Africa land stlitm. comm. board, 1919; asst. sec., E. Africa currency prin., 1st Apr., 1920; hon. sec., Coromandel coast, since 1921; sec., comte., on governor's pr., 1927-28; ag. sec. to 1st Oct., 1930.

JEFFRIES, CHARLES WILLIAM, F.L.S.—B. 1882; Computer, Royal Observat. Greenwich, 1897; junr. ast., Royal Observat. Cape of Good Hope, 1902; 1st ast., Observatory, Hong Kong, 1907; chief nat. obs., 1912; ag. dir. in 1915, 1920, 1924, 1929; dir., 1932.

JEKYLL, LIEUT.-COL. SIR HEBERT, K.C.M.G. (1901), R.E., C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1846; R.E., Apr., 1866; employed under Warren and Trinity House in 1868 to 1874; destruction of sunken ships, from mining, and under G.P.O. in the mail dept., from 1870 to 1873, and 1874 to 1877; served in the campaign of 1873-74; G. Coast; priv. sec. to the Earl of Carnarvon, Jan., 1877, to Feb., 1878; sec. to the defence comm., 1878; sec. to the royal commission on the defence of Br. possessions abroad, 1879-82; specially employed in Egypt and report on the defences of Singapore, 1883-4; sec. col. defence comm., priv. sec. to Lord Carnarvon, viceroy of India, June, 1885, to Jan., 1886; sec. to royal commission for Melbourne centennial exhibition, priv. sec. to lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1886; sec. to the roy. comm. for the Paris Exhibition, 1900.

JELF, SIR ARTHUR SELBORNE, K.T., B.A., C.M.G. (1927).—B. 1876; ed. Marlborough, Exeter Coll., Oxford (extr.), 2nd cls. clk., 1897; 3rd cls. lit. hum., 1899; B.A., 1899; 1913; cadet, F.M.S. div. serv., 1899; held admstr. and exec. posts in Malay States; asst. gen. adviser to Johore gov't. asst. offr. of cls. IV., Jan., 1912; chmn. of Kinta, Perak, Apr., 1914 to Apr., 1915; lieut., M.S.V.R., Sep., 1914; lieut.-gen., Jan., 1915; seconded for mil. service (general list), Apr., 1917; offr. of cls. IV., 1917; tempy. capt., gen. staff, S. command; attchd. gen. staff, W.O. (mil.), Jan., 1918; H. M. Petroleum Krec. (sec. Harcourt's comte.), June, 1918; offr., June, 1919; ag. under sec. to gov't., F.M.S., 1920; dir., Malayan polit. intell. burea.
Dec., 1921; mem., Br. Malaya opium comte., Dec., 1923; pres., estates health comm., Apr., 1924 (retd. thanks of S. of S.); col. sec., Jamaica, Oct., 1925; ag. gov., for various periods 1925-32; lieut.-col., local forces, Oct., 1927.

JELLIFFE, 1ST VISCOUNT OF SOAPA (GREAT. 1918) — Sir John Rushworth JELLIFFE, O.M. (1916), G.C.B. (1915), G.C.V.O. (1916). — B. 1859; entd. navy, 1872; served in Egyptian war, 1882; China expeditionary force, 1900; European war, 1914-16; battle of Jutland; naval asst. to controller, 1901-3; dir. of naval ordnance, 1905-7; A.D.C. to King Edward VII., 1906-7; 3rd sea lord of the Admiralty and controller of the navy, 1908-10; comdr.-in-chief of the Atlantic fleet, 1910-11; and of the Grand Fleet, 1914-16; 2nd sea lord of the Admiralty, 1912-14; 1st sea lord, 1916-17; admiral of the fleet, 1919; governor-general of New Zealand, 1920-24; G.C. Legion of Honour, and Croix de Guerre (France); G.C. Order of Leopold, and Croix de Guerre (Belgium); St. George 3 (Russia); G.C.R.S. with Pavlovna (Japan); G.C. Savoia (Italy).

JENKINS, EDWARD ENOCH, M.A., LL.B. (Cantab.), Barrister-at-Law (Grays Inn). — B. 1895; war service, France, 1914-19; cadet, Nyasaland, Nov., 1925; asst. regisr., N. Rhodesia, Nov., 1927; crown coun., Apr., 1930; ag. solr.-gen. on various occasions, 1931-32; ag. atty.-gen. on various occasions, 1931-32.

JENKINS, REGINALD FREDERICK. — B. 1901; entered C.O., 30th Nov., 1916; apptd., after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1918; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; seconded to Empire Marketing bd., 1926; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st Feb., 1928.

JENKS, J. C. A. — Ed. Bristol Gram. Schl. and Angers, France; awarded Croix-de-Guerre (Palm) 1917; Order of Saint Stanislaus with Swords (2nd cls.), and ment. in desps., 1919; colonial audit serv., 1920; asst. audr., Kenya Colony, Apr., 1920; asst. audr. in charge, Zanzibar, Mar., 1923; senr. asst. audr. in charge, Jan., 1926; mem., retrenchment and rev. comte., Zanzibar, 1927; Order of Brilliant Star of Zanzibar (5th cls.), 1928; senr. asst. audr. in charge, Kenya and Uganda rly. and harbors., 1929; audr., Mauritius, 1933.

JENNER, FRANK. — B. 1878; served in Cape Mounted Rifles, Bechuana land campaign, 1896-97; S. African war, 1899-1901; sub-inspr., Basuto-land Mounted Pol., 1901; inspr., 1910; supt., leper stltnt., 1914; comantr., 1920.

JENNINGS, F. G. — Asst. dist. comsrr., E.A.P., Apr., 1919.

JENNINGS, PERCIVAL HENRY. — B. 1903; ed. Christ's Hosp.; col. audit dept., 1926; asst. audr., N. Rhodesia, 1927; asst. audr., Mauritius, 1931; ag. audr., 1932.

JEPSON, FRANK PRICE. — B. 1885; M.A., Pembroke Coll., Camb.; exhibr., medallist, and dip. in agri. (hons. in entomology), Wye Agric. Coll., Kent, 1906; trop. disease research fund student in med. entomology, Camb. Univ., 1907; assisted in investgtn. by L.G.B. on flies as carriers of infection, 1908 and 1909; govt. entomologist, Fiji, 1909; offl. visits to Hawaii, 1911, Samoa, 1912, Java, 1913; asst. entomologist, Ceylon, 1919; ag. entomologist in addn., July, 1923 to Mar., 1924 and Oct. to Nov., 1925; del. to Imp. Agril. Research Conf., Lond., 1927; on sp. serv., U.S.A. (termite investgn.), 1928.

JERRAM, JAMES HARVLOCK. — B. 1879; ed. Thames High Schl. and Auckland Gram. Schl., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. state fire insurance office, 1905; acct. 1906; dep. gen. man., 1908; gen. man., 1923.

JERVOISE, RICHARD SOMERVELL. — B. 1887; ed. Bradfield Coll. and Magdalen Coll., Oxford (hist. demy); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; asst. dist. offr., Jan., 1920; dist. offr., July, 1920; offr., ols. III., Nov., 1923; shmn., sany. bd., Larut, Jan. and Oct., 1924; 1st mag. and regr., sup. ct., Johore Bharu, Oct., 1924; ch. asst. dist. offr., Kinta, Aug., 1925; ch. ag. asst. treas. F.M.S., and state treas., Selangor, Sept., 1928; offr., ols. II., Nov., 1928; mag., Ipoh, Nov., 1929; collr., estate duty, F.M.S., offl. assignee and regisr., companies, F.M.S. in addn., Apr., 1931.

JESSE, WILLIAM. — B. 1895; ed. Marlborough Coll.; served Indian Army R. of O., 1916-19; Afghan campaign, 1919; Calcutta Light Horse, 1921-22; apptd. treas., Kenya, 1924; asst. treas., Uganda, Jan., 1925; asst. currency offr., Uganda, 1927-28 and 1933.

JEWELL, MORTON, M.B.E. (1931). — B. 1880; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Apr., 1899; conf. clk., 1911; deptl. astt., 1st Apr., 1922; staff offr., establishments, 1st June, 1928.

JOBLING, GEOFFREY LIONEL. — B. 1899; ed. Bowen Schl., Brisbane; called to bar, Jan., 1926 (Gray's Inn); served German S.W. Africa, 1914-15; R.A.F., 1918-19; law dept., B.S.A. Co., N. Rhodesia, Nov., 1915; asst. regisr., high ct., N. Rhodesia; asst. offr. recr. in bankcy., asst. admin. gen., asst. regisr., lands and deeds, asst. regisr., births, deaths and marriages, asst. regisr. companies, asst. custodian enemy property, asst. contr. local clearing office, asst. regisr., high ct., etc., Uganda, June, 1927; crown coun., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1929.

JOHNS, BRIAN MAURICE, M.B., Ch.B. (N.Z.), F.R.C.S. (Ed.), D.T.M. & H. (Eng.). — B. 1901; med. offr., S.S., Mar., 1928; prof., clin. surgery, King Edward VII Coll. of Med., S'pore, Aug., 1928.

JOHNS, FRED, F.J.I. — B. 1868; ed. Cornwall, England; on Adelaide newspaper literary staffs from 1885 to 1914; leader of the first offl. Hansard staff, S. Australian parlt., since July, 1914; author of "John's Notable Australians" (1906 and 1908), and of "Australasia's Prominent People," "Who's Who in Australia" (seven editions), and "A Journalist's Jottings"; hon. sec. of Adelaide branch of Royal Society of St. George, and hon. sec., Matthew Flinders' National Statue, City of Adelaide; also hon. sec., Princess Mary wedding gift fund, S. Australia.

JOHNS, ROBERT. — B. 1903; ed. Monmouthshire Agr. Inst., Usk, and Univ. Coll. of Wales, Aberystwyth; Imp. Coll. Agr. Exp., Trinidad; N.D.A., C.D.A., C.D.D., A.I.C.T.A.; stock inspr., Tanganyika, 1926; C.O. agril. research scholar, Trinidad, and Univ. of Reading, 1929-30; agril. offr., Zanzibar, 1931.

JOHNSON, CHARLES WALTER TREVOR. — B. 1893; Fiji serv., 1910; col. sec.'s office, 1915; 1st cls. clk. and clk. to exec. and leg. couns., 1920; ag. pty. sec. to ag. gov. on three occasions; seconded for serv. in W. Pacific high comsn. as dist. offr., Fanning Island, Feb.-Nov., 1922; ch. clk., secretariat, 1927; ag. prov. and dist. comsrr., June-Sept., 1928; ag. asst. col. sec., Nov., 1929; 2nd asst. col. sec., 1931; ag. 1st asst. col. sec., Nov., 1932 to Aug., 1933.

JOHNSON, E. T. — B. 1875; ed. Sedbergh Schl. and Trinity Hall (Camb.); B.A., LL.B. (Law Tripos, 1902); res. mag., E. Africa Prot., 1915; senr. res. mag., Kenya, Dec., 1922
judge, in 1924-25 and 1928-29; puisne judge, Zanzibar, 1929; ag. ch. just., 1932.

JOHNSON, ELLEN M., M.B.E. (1930).—B. 1873; ast. clk., post office, Sept., 1914; ch. clk., Jan., 1924; ag. postmtr. in 1925 and 1930; ast. postmtr., June, 1926; ag. postmtr., Aug. to Sept., 1932.

JOHNSON, FREDERICK ENGLAND, I.S.O. (1932), A.F.I.A. (Australia).—B. 1878; served in S. African war, 1899-1901 (Queen's medal, 3 clasps); inspr. of native labourers, British residency, New Hebrides, 1908; in charge of accts. of British residency, 1909; ag. comm. of British div. of native constab., 1908, 1910, 1912, and from 1914, in addition to other duties; is also a dep. commr. of the high commr.'s off. for the W. Pacific, and ag. regis. of high commr.'s off., in the New Hebrides; treas. and collr. of cust., Br. Solomon Is., Nov., 1919; offi. mem., advisory coun., 1927.

JOHNSON, CAPT. GEORGE BENJAMIN, M.R.S.T.—B. 1884; ed. Ryde's Sch., Devonport and Cheltenham Training Coll. (dipl. educn.); Leicestershire Regt. and gen. staff, 1915-19; rev. of offs., T.A.; ag. vice-consul, Le Havre, 1920; headmnr., Zanzibar educn. dept., 1920; ditto and inspr., schls., 1925; ch. inspr., schls., 1928; ag. dir., educn. for various periods, 1920-33; temp. mem., L.C., 1928, 1930, 1932-33; temp. mem., E.C., 1932-33.

JOHNSON, GEORGE CUNYNGHAM.—B. 1875; 2nd clk., treas., St. Kitts, Apr., 1894; 2nd clk. admstr.'s office and clk. of legis. coun., Mar., 1896; clk. to admstr. and clk. of couns., Jan., 1901; treas. and compt. cust., St. Kitts-Nevis, June, 1923; ag. admstr., St. Kitts-Nevis, June, 1923; offi. mem., exec. and legis. couns., St. Kitts-Nevis and offi. mem., Fed. exec. coun.; censor, St. Kitts during the war; is a J.P. for St. Kitts-Nevis; ag. col. sec., Leeward Is. and admstr. govt., Antigua, June, 1926; ag. commr., Montserrat, Feb., 1927.

JOHNSON, JOHN, M.I.M. AND C.E.—Ast. engnr., P.W.D., N. Nigeria, 1913; astd., R.W.A.F.F., Cameroons Exped., 1914-15; senr. exec. engnr., P.W.D., Nigeria, 1927.

JOHNSON, JOHN COLEMAN DE GRAY, O.B.E. (1933).—B. 1884; ed. Wesleyan Coll. Sch., Cape Coast; 5th grade clk., Ashanti, 1907; 4th grade clk., police dept., 1912; ast. inspr. W. and M., 1914; ast. sec. for native affrs. Mar., 1920; mem., Accra town coun., Jan., 1928.

JOHNSON, WALTER BURFORD, L.R.C.P., M.B., B.S. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Eng.).—B. 1885; med. offr., N. Nigeria, 1912; seconded for sp. investig. work under yellow fever commr., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1913 to May, 1914; temp. capt., gen. list, 1914-15; testee investigator, 1921; specialist, 1921; dir., med. and sanry. services, Nigeria, Mar., 1929.

JOHNSON, HON. SIR WILLIAM ELLIOT, K.C.M.G. (1920).—B. 1862; speaker of the H. of R., C. of A., 1913-14 and 1917-23; ret. from politic.

JOHNSON, WILLIAM JOSEPH, O.B.E. (1927).—B. 1892; serv. in I.E.F., E. Africa, 1914-17; ment. in desps., 1917; transf. to depot, 111th Mahars, India, 1917; offr. in charge, clearing house, office of field contr. of mily. accts., E.E.F., Cairo, 1918; major, ch. accts. offr., O.E.T. admstr., Palestine, 1919; treas., Palestine civ. admstr., July, 1920; dep. treas. on abolition of post of finan. sec., May, 1922; ag. treas. and mem., exec. and advisory couns. for various periods, 1923-28; mem., comitee. on pub. security forces, 1923; mem., comitee. on establishment of pensionable cadre for gen. clerks, 1925; mem., road bd., 1926; mem., ry. currency offr., Jan.-June, 1928; treas., 1928.

JOHNSTON, H. LINDSAY.—Govt. max. Australia, 1916.

JOHNSTON, JOHN ROOKE.—B. 1896; Ninians, Moffat and St. Bees Schs., Sandhurst; 2nd lieut., The Black Watch, Dec., 1917; seconded to 2/1st K.A.R., Dec., 1920; adminis. offr., Tanganyika Ter., 12th Sept., 1923.

JOHNSTON, SIR REGINALD FRANCIS, K.C.M.G. (1930), C.M.G. (1928), C.B.E. (1884); M.A. Magdalen Coll., Oxford; Gray prizeman, Edin. Univ., 1894; prix Lord Rector's essay, Edin.; hon. in hist., mod. hist. and constitutional law, exhib., Magd. Coll., Oxford, 1894; mem. causa Stanhope Essay, 1896; B.A., 1896; Hong Kong, 1898; ag. clk. of couns., 1899; sec. to gov., 1900-01; ag. ast. col. sec., 1901; J.P., June, 1902; sec. to gov't., Wellawatte dist. offr. and mag., ditto, 1906; sec. to serv. as tutor to Manchu Emperor (ex-China), 1919-26; rec'd. from Emperor highest offl. grade and sable robe, 1922; Summer Palace, Peking, 1924; brought into safety in legation quarter, Pekin, 1924; sec., Br. China indemnity deleg., commr., Weihsaiwei, 1927-30.

JOHNSTON, WILLIAM—B. 1890; ast. G.P.O., May, 1910; offr., cust. and excise, 1911; dep. collr., cust., Mauritius, Dec., 1911; harbr. bd., 1922-25; chmn., dist. tax. tariff advisory bd., 1927-31; chmn. on various occasions, 1927-30; commr. of tobacco in addn., 1927-31 and ag. sup. rev., May to July, 1929; ag. collr., exc. harbrmr., M.L.C., on various occasions; collr.gen., Jamaica, Jan., 1932.

JOHNSTONE, ANGUS COLLIN DUNBAR (1889); ed. Trin. Coll., Glenalmond, and many; passed Army entrance exam., Sandhurst, 1906; higher grade stf. G. Rly., 1909-12; served, Balkan War, wth. Cross Unit attd. Turkish Forces, 1912-13; 5th (Res.) Batt. West Yorks Regt. (T.), 1914 to Apr., 1915; ast. dist. commr., Coast, 10th Sept., 1913; lieut., W.A.F., astd. Gold Coast Regt., Apr., 1915; ast. Br. Forces, Togoland, May, 1915; offr. in polit. serv., Jan., 1920; dist. commr., Akim, Sept., 1922; prov. commr., Accra commr., S. Prov., Aug., 1929; ag. chmn. N. Territories in addn. Dec., 1929 to Jan., 1930.

JOHNSTONE, BANNER CARETHEUS (1930).—B. 1882; ed. Eton and Trin. Coll., B.A. (Cantab.); passed R.G.S. survey, 1908; ast. supt., surveys, Ceylon, Oct.; best. collr. (afterwards ast. dist. commr.), Assam Prot., Apr., 1913; ag. 1st ast. clk. of coun., Nov., 1914 to June, 1916; land attlit. offr., Jan., 1916; seconded to serv. in German E. Africa, Aug., 1916; mil. serv., France, Oct., 1916 to May; ag. dist. commr., Pemba, July, 1919 to 1920; dist. commr., Pemba, Nov., 1920; senr. commr., Aug., 1924 to Feb., 1925; Order of the Brilliant Star of Zanzibar; ag. senr. commr. from Oct., 1926 to Apr., mem., leg. coun.; prov. commr., 1928.

JOHNSTONE, JAMES MONTAGUE (1898).—Ent. prison dept. (England and Wales).
1921; dep. ast. supt., prisons, Trinidad, 1924; ast. supt., 1927.

JOHNSTONE, JOHN WILKIE.—B. 1884; solr., England, 1906; ast. polit. off., G.E.A. (Tanganyika Territory), Nov., 1918; ag. mag., Apr., 1919 to Feb., 1921; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1924; res. mag., Apr., 1929.

JOHNSTONE, SIR ROBERT STEWART, K.T. BACH. (1915).—Ed. at Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A. (honors and medal in history and political science), 1882; LL.B., 1884; M.A., 1895; Holt scholar, Gray's Inn, 1885; called to the Irish bar 1886; called to the bar at Gray's Inn, Jan., 1889; lieut., 3rd (Militia) Batt. Manchester Regt., 1883; capt., 1887; dist. commnr., Lagos, 1889; served on Lagos and Porto Novo boundary commn., 1890; stip. and circuit mag. and judge of ct. of com. pleas., Bahamas, Jan., 1894; ag. atty.-gen., Aug. to Nov., 1902; ch. just., Grenada, 1909; ret., 1914.

JOMARON, ADOLPHE CHARLES.—B. 1893; ed. at University Coll. Schi. and Corpus Christi Coll., Camb. (class. schol.)—B.A. 1920; 2nd lieut., R.F.A., 1914; lieut., 1915; capt., 1917; ag. major, 1918; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1920, attd. to ast. adviser's office, Muar, Johore; 2nd ast. adviser, Muar, Johore, Jan., 1922; offr., cls. V., June, 1922; ast. state audr., chmn., conservancy bd., Khota Bharu and coroner, June, 1924; offr., cls IV., June, 1925; 3rd ast. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Nov., 1925; sec. to rivers commrs. in addn., Dec., 1927; offr., cls. III, June, 1930; 2nd ast. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Nov., 1930; hon. A.D.C. to high commnr., Mar., 1931; ag. pub. trustee and offl. admstr., F.M.S., May, 1931.

JONES, CHARLES ERNEST.—B. 1892; B.A., B.Sc., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1914; attd. to Kegalla kach., Dec., 1914; Ratnapura kach., Apr., 1915; Kegalla kach., Jan., 1916; censor's off., Apr., 1916; on mil. duty, 1918; returned to censor's off., June, 1919; pol. mag., Matare, July, 1919; sec., retrenchment commn., Jan., 1922; addnl. ast. dir., educn., Dec., 1923; dist. judge, N'Elia, Apr., 1925; ast. govt. agt., Mannar, Nov., 1925; ast. col. treas., Sept., 1928; ast. govt. agt., Matale, June, 1929; dep. collr., cust., Sept., 1933.

JONES, G. A.—B. 1889; appt., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Dec., 1907; ast. sec. to Oversea Prize Disposal Comtee., Mar., 1917; ag. sec. to ditto, Jan., 1918; promoted, under O.in-C. of 1910, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 14th Mar., 1919; prin., 1st Apr., 1920.

JONES, GWYLLYM ARTHUR.—Agric. diploma, Univ. Coll., Bangor, N. Wales, with 1st cls. in agric.; awarded Wm. Griffith prize, 1906-8; holder of certif. in forestry; ag. agric. and science master, Antigua gram. schl., 1909; ast. curator, botanic gardens, Dominica, Aug., 1909; in charge of agric. schl., Dominica, Aug., 1909, to Jan., 1910; ast. sec. to permanent exhibtn. comtee., 1909; ag. curator, botanic gardens, Dominica, 1913; chemist, agric. dept., Dominica, Apr., 1915, and a director of the Victoria museum, 1915.

JONES, LLEWELYN A. F.—Ast. dist. commnr., E.A.P., 18th Dec., 1908; jurn. ast. sec., Feb., 1912; priv. sec. to govt., 1915; dist. commnr., June, 1916; ag. senr. commnr., Kenya, 1926 and 1928; prov. commnr. (2nd grade), 1929.

JONES, MALCOLM LUDLOW, O.B.E. (1919).—Served at Bd. of Trade (Labour Dept.), 1897-1901; chief clk., Emigrants' Information Office, 1901; visited Canada on behalf of E.L.O., 1907; chief clk., Oversea Settmt. Office, 1919.

JONES, CAPT. NELSON, M.C. and Bar.—B. 1895; ed. Glasgow Univ.; commdr., Cameron Highlands, 1915; discharged on account of wounds, Apr., 1919; cadet, F.M.S., Oct., 1919; ast. contr., lab., Penang, Mar., 1920; ditto, K. Lumpur, May, 1921; passed cadet, Dec., 1921; ast. dist. office, Klang to act as 1st cls. mag., 1923; 3rd mag. S'pore, July, 1924; offr., cls. IV, Oct., 1926; ast. advr., Kukup, May, 1929; ag. emigrn. commnr., Malaya, Madras, Apr., 1931; offr., cls. III, Oct., 1931; mag., J. Bahru, Jan., 1933.

JONES, PERCY SYDNEY TWENTYMAN.—B. 1876; ed. at Diocesan Coll., Rondebosch; White prize for classics; Archbishop's Greek testament prize; B.A., Cape, 1896; LL.B., Cape, 1898; called to bar, Aug., 1898; took silk, 1924; edited "Liquor Laws of Cape," and jointly with H. O. Buckle "Magistrates' Court Practice of S.A."; judge, Aug., 1926.

JONES, ROBERT NOBLE, C.B.E. (1928).—B. 1864; barrister and solr., N.Z., 1890; judge, native land ct. and dist. land regnr., 1903; chief judge, native land ct., 1919; under sec., native dept., 1922; native trustee, 1933.

JONES, SAMUEL BENJAMIN, M.B.E. (1924), M.A. (Durb.), B.A. (Lond.), Inter. LL.B. Exam. (Lond.), L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S. (Edin.), L.R.F.P.S. (Glasg.).—B. 1874; ed. Antigua Gram. Schi.; med. offr., and mag., Anguilla, 1918; thanked by exec. coun. of St. Kitts for checking outbreak of small pox in Anguilla, 1921; med. offr., dist. No. 2, St. Kitts, 1924.

JONES, STANLEY BOSCAWEN.—Ch. acct.'s office, Beira and Mashonaland and Rhodesia Rly., Bulawayo, 1912-18; 2nd Rhodesia Regt., 1914-17; ast. native commnr., and native commnr., N. Rhodesia, 1918-28; ast. dist. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1928; dist. offr., Oct., 1929.

JONES, STANLEY WILSON.—B. 1888; B.A. (Manchester), 1st cls. hons. hist. (1908); cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1911; ag. ast. dist. offr., Pekan, June, 1912; passed cadet, Dec., 1913; offr., cls. V, Dec., 1914; ast. dist. offr., Pekan, Aug., 1917; do., K. Kangsar, June, 1918; offr., cls. IV, Jan., 1919; dist. offr., Jelebu; Jan. 1920; do., K. Lipis, May, 1920; local examr. in law and Malay, Nov., 1923; offr., cls. III, Dec., 1923; attd. to fed. sec. on sp. duty, Aug., 1924; local examr. in Malay, Selangor, Sept., 1924; offr., cls. II, Dec., 1928; offr., cls. IB, May, 1931; ag. gen. advr., Johore, Feb., 1933.

JONES, WILLIAM JOHN ANDREW, B.A. (Oxford).—B. 1889; ed. Jesus Coll., Oxford; ast. dist. commnr., Gold Coast, Mar., 1913; dist. commnr., Dec., 1918; dep. prov. commnr., Jan., 1924; prov. commnr., July, 1927; sec., native affrs., 1930; ag. col. sec., 1930, 1931 and 1932; gov't. dep., Sept., 1932; ch. commnr., N. Territories, 1933.

JONES-BATEMAN, REGINALD.—B. 1894; on mil. serv., Sept., 1914; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1919; attached to Kurunegala Kach., Dec., 1919; office ast. to supt. of census and dir. of statistics, Oct., 1921; pol. mag., Jaffna, Oct., 1924; ast. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Nov., 1924; ast. govt. agt., Kandy, Dec., 1926; ast. stimt. offr., Aug., 1927.

JORDAN, ARTHUR BENJAMIN.—B. 1890; ed. Nottingham High Schi., and Jesus Coll., Oxford (class. exhibr.)—B.A., Oxon., 1913; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1913; passed final exam. in Cantonese, Apr., 1916; 2nd lieut., M.V.I., 1916; passed cadet, Dec., 1916; offr., cls. V, offr. as ast. contr. of lab., K. Lumpur, Dec., 1916; ast. contr. of lab., K. Lumpur, Jan., 1917; lieut., M.V.I.,
Dec., 1918; asst. dist. offr., Raub (Bentong), Feb., 1919; offr., cls. IV, Nov., 1920; asst. prot. of Chinese, N. Sembilan, Apr., 1921; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1925; prot., Chinese, Negri Sembilan, Oct., 1926; offr., cls. II, Nov., 1930; prot., Chinese, Selangor and Pahang, Dec., 1930; mem., Br. deleg. to L. of N. Opium Conf., Bangkok, Nov., 1931; prot., Chinese, Selangor and Pahang, Nov., 1932; offr., cls. I.A., Oct., 1933.

JORDAN, A. H.—B. 1903; ent. C.O., 17th Mar., 1919; cler. offr., 14th Oct., 1921.

JOSEPHS, HECTOR ARCHIBALD, B.A., LL.M. (Trinity Hall, Camb.), K.O. (Jamaica, 1911, Br. Guiana, 1921).—Called to Bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1896; ag. asst. atty.-gen., Jamaica, 1907, 1908, 1909, 1910; asst. atty.-gen., 1912; ag. atty.-gen. on various occasions, 1914-24; temp. atty.-gen., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1921 to Apr., 1923; ag. puisne judge, Jamaica, 1924-25; referee of titles, Jamaica, 1924-25; nom.-mem., leg. coun., Jamaica, 1924-25; attv.-gen., Br. Guiana, 1925; ag. ch. just., 1932; chmn., several select and other comtes., Jamaica and Br. Guiana.

Joubert, M. J. A., B.S.A. (Toronto).—B. 1882; pupil teacher, O.F.S., 1897; asst. to govt. agronomist, O.F.S., 1906; itinerant instr., agr., 1910; offr.-in.ch. and prin., Glen schl. of agr., 1913; prin., schl. of agr., Glen., 1917; prin., Grootfontein schl. of agr. (Cape), 1927; asst. ch. dir., plant industry, dept. agr., Pretoria, 1929; ch. divn. of agr. educ. and extension, Pretoria, 1932; under-sec., agr., 1933.

Joy, George Andrew.—B. 1896; ed. St. Francis Xavier's Coll., Bruges; ent. Army, 1914; served in Belgium and France, 1915 and 1916; Palestine and Syria, 1917-18; staff gen. headqrs., Egypt and Palestine, 1919-20; S.W. Arabia, 1921 to 1923; ment. in despatches, Lieut., R.A.R.O., Feb., 1919; asst. to res. commr., New Hebrides, Aug., 1924; dep. commr., W. Pacific, July, 1926; ag. Br. res. commr., Aug., 1927; res. commr., New Hebrides, 1928; temp. attd., staff of col. development advisory comte., C.O., Jan., 1931.

Joyce, G. F. W. C.—B. 1897; ent. E.I.O., June, 1912; asst. clk., Jan., 1915; on mily. serv., Sept., 1914 to Apr., 1919; cler. offr., O.S.O., 1st Jan., 1920.

Joynt, Henry Raymond, B.A.—B. 1888; ed. Bradfield, and Balliol Coll., Oxon. (math. schol.); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; passed cadet, July, 1914; dist. offr., K. Langat, Nov., 1919; dep. contr. of lab., Seremban, Mar., 1921; agt. to food contr., N. Sembilan in addn., Apr. to July, 1921; on sp. duty, rubber census office, Kuala Lumpur, June, 1922; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1923; second asst. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Nov., 1923; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1928; attd. lab. dept., Kuala Lumpur, June, 1929; ag. dep. contr., lab., Malaya, Jan.-Aug., 1930; commr., lands and mines, Johore, Apr., 1931; ag. finan. advr. and treas., F.M.S., May, 1933.

Junner, Major Norman Ross, M.C., I.K.D.I.C., M.Inst.M.M.—B. 1891; ed. Melb. Univ. and Imp. Coll. of Sc. and Technol., 1851 exhibtn. schol. for Melbourne Univ.; lect. in geology, schol. of Mines, Ballarat, 1853 war serv. in France, Italy and Malta, 1853; geologist, Gold Coast geol. surv., 1859; Sierra Leone geol. surv., 1872; dir. Gold Co. geol. surv., Oct., 1890.

Kane, Edward William, C.M.G.—B. 1880; J.P.—Ed. Marist schol. and Braun's coll. Wellington, N.Z.; record clk. in immigr., 1880; resigned; joined partly. staff, 1881; served in various offices; clk. house of rep., 1884; clk. of parlia. and clk. of leg. coun., 1890.

Kannangara, Charles Henry.—B. 1880; cls. V Ceylon civ. serv., Oct., 1928; asst. Matara kach., Oct., 1928.

Kannangara, Edward Wilmore.—B. 1880; B.A., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., loco, Aug., 1919; attd. to Kandy kach., Aug., 1920; attd. Batticaloa Kach., Jan., 1920; sec. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo, Arissawella, 1921; pol. mag., Avissawella, Mar., 1925; Jaffna, Nov., 1924; ditto, Balapitiya, Jun., 1925; asst. commr., stamps, Jan., 1929; addl. govt. agr., Columbo, Mar., 1930; sec. to agr. and lands, Nov., 1931; clk., estate, June, 1933.

Kantawala, Mohan Harcourt.—B. 1890; M.A.; Cantab.; barrister-at-law; Gray's Inn; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1915; att. Anuradhapura kach., July, 1915; addl. pol. mag., Anuradhapura, July, 1915; addl. pol. mag. and addl. mag., Colombo, July, 1917; pol. mag., Avissawella, Mar., 1918; office asst. to govt. Prov., Oct., 1919; pol. mag., Negombo, 1921; ditto, Panadura, June, 1923; dist. judge, Pedro, Nov., 1924; ag. dist. judge, Mauna, 1927; addl. dist. judge, Jaffna, June, 1927; dist. judge, Ratnapura, Mar., 1928; asst. agr., Columbo, Sept., 1929; dist. judge, Negombo, Mar., 1930; pol. mag., Galle, June, 1933.

Kaufmann, Hilary Pilkington (Cantab.).—B. 1892; on mil. serv., Aug., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Apr., 1920; attd. to Jaffna, June, 1920; ag. office asst. to govt. Prov., May, 1921; pol. mag., Balarama, 1922; dep. rubber contr., Nov., 1923; dist. judge, Kandy, Feb., 1925; pol. mag., Colombo, 1926; asst. govt. agr., Colombo, Sept., 1926; chmn., munic. conn., Kandy, Oct., 1931.

Kaufmann, John Ernest.—B. Umata, 1900; clk., conservator of forests, Umata, 1901; senr. clk., ditto, 1902; nat. forest offr., Umata, 1903; transf. to Kandy, 1912; dist. forest offr., Kokstad, 1912; nat. forest offr., Knysna, 1923; 2nd grade conserv. of forest conservancy, 1926; conserv. of forest conservancy, 1927; ditto, Midland conservancy, 1929; ditto, Eastern conservancy, 1931; inspr., E. inspectorate, 1932.

Kauntze, W. H., B.A., M.D., Camb. Univ.), M.B., B.S. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. L.R.C.P. (Lond.), Cert. London H.S. (1st place and med.), D.P.H. (Viet.), African med. staff, Jan., 1914 to Jan., 1916; seconded for serv., E. Africa Feb., 1916 to Jan., 1919; ment. in despatches; and asst. bacteriologist, Kenya, Jan., laboratory services, Kenya, Apr., 1919; and san. services, Uganda, Nov., 1922.
KAY, WILLIAM, M.A. (Edin.)—B. 1887; Hong Kong educn. dept., 1913; head, Queen's Coll., 1933.

KAY-MOUAT, JOHN RICHARD, M.A., Oxon and Hon. Cause Adelaide, M.Sc., M.B., B.Ch., D.P.H., Bristol.—B. 1881; formerly asst. demonstr., physiology, Oxford Univ.; demonstr., pathology, Bristol Univ. and pathologist to R. Infirmary, Bristol; temp. surg. lieut. to R. Naval Divn., Aug., 1914; ag. surg. lieut. comdr. for anti-malarial work, Sierra Leone, May, 1918; demob. to act temp. as prof. of pathology, Bristol Univ., April, 1919; asst. prin. Coll. of Medicine, Singapore, Mar., 1921; ag. prin. in 1921 and 1922 and 1926-28; prof. of physiology, Nov., 1921; lect. in pharmacology, June, 1923; del. to jubilee, Adelaide Univ., Aug., 1926.

KEAST, MAJOR SYDNEY BANKS, R.E. (R. of O.), M.C. and Bar, French Croix de Guerre—B. 1884; ed. City of London Sch.; Suvan P.W.D., 1906-13; suptg. sany. engrn., P.W.D., Gold Coast, 1913; Camerons E.F., 1915-16; B.E.F., 1916-19; senr. pub. health engrn., 1924; asst. D.P.W., 1926; dep. D.P.W., 1928; D.P.W., 1932; lt.-col. commdg. Gold Coast Defence Force, 1931.

KEATES, CAPT. E. H. O., M.C., F.R.G.S.—B. 1896; ed. St. Peter's Sch., York; on mili. serv. France and Belgium, 1915-18, Ger., 1919; adminstr. offr., N. Nigeria, 1921; asst. treas., Nigeria, 1925.

KEATINGE, WILLIAM MAYBURY, B.A., LL.D.—B. 1879; ed. Monmouth Gram. Schl. and Trinity Coll., Dublin (Jellett prizeman); B.A., LL.B. (1900); L.L.D. (1903); solr., 1904; admstr.-gen., regis. of deeds, and sec., Walf coman., Zanzibar, Mar., 1915; joint custodian of enemy property and liquidator of enemy firms, Nov., 1915; offl. trustee, 1919; contr., local clearing office, Nov., 1920; regis.-gen., pub. trustee and offl. recr., Kenya, June, 1924.

KEEGAN, R. J.—B. 1901; ed. R.M.C., Sandhurst; lieut., Indian Army; served, N.W. Frontier and Iraq; asst. to commdt., pol. (Br. divn.), New Hebrides, Sept., 1927; ag. act., Jan. to June, 1928 and Mar. to Nov., 1930; ag. dist. agt., Estate and commdt., constab., Nov., 1929 to June, 1930.

KEEN, KENNETH.—B. 1907; ed. King's Schl., Rochester, Guy's Hosp. and King's Coll., London; cadet, Hong Kong, 1930.

KEET, JOHAN DIEDEIK MOHR.—Asst. dist. forest offr., working plans, eastern conservancy, Jan., 1908; asst. dist. forest offr., Keiskama Hoek, Jan., 1909; ag. dist. forest offr., Keiskama Hoek, Jan., 1914; ag. dist. forest offr., Knysna, Nov., 1915; dist. forest offr., Knysna, Apr., 1917; conservr. of forests, Transvaal, Mar., 1923; ch. forest offr. (ch., divn. of forest management), 1932.

KEIR, ALEXANDER, M.A., U.D.A.—B. 1884; ed. Fordyce Acad. and Aberdeen Univ.; M.A. (Aberdeen), 1905; diploma, agr., Cambridge Univ., 1913; educ. dept., S.S. and F.M.S., 1906; inspr., schls., Selangor, 1911; head, Malay training coll., Matang, 1913; inspr., schls., Perak, 1920; repd. British Malaya at Imp. conf. on educn., 1923; ag. ch. inspr., English schls., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1923 to Sept., 1924 and June, 1931; inspr., schls., Perak, Sept., 1924; del. for British Malaya to Imp. Educn. Confce. June to July, 1927; inspr., schls., Perak, Apr., 1929.

KEITH-ROACH, EDWARD, O.B.E. (1927), Commdr. of Order of St. John of Jerusalem.—B. 1885; ed. privately; 2nd lieut., 7th Lancs. Fuslrs., Aug., 1914; capt., Nov., 1914; major, July, 1915; seconded, gen. staff, G.H.Q., E.E.F., July, 1915; Bimbashi, Egyptian Army, May, 1916; intell. offr., Sudan govt., May, 1916; inspr., Port Sudan, Aug., 1916; Darfur Exped., and first inspr., Umkedada, Darfur, Oct., 1916 (Sudan Med. and Bar); 2nd cls. mag., 1916; dist. comntr., Eastern Darfur, Jan., 1917; passed Sudan govt. Arabic exam., 1917; 1st cls. mag., June, 1917; pub. cust., enemy property in Palestine, under occupied enemy territory adminstr., Dec., 1919; 1st asst. sec., Palestine govt., 11th Oct., 1920; lent to C.O. by Palestine govt. and ag. prin., Feb., 1924 to Feb., 1925; asst. dist. comntr., N. dist., 1st Oct., 1925; dep. dist. comntr., Jerusalem divn., 12th Nov., 1926; publications, "Darfur, a Province of the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan," "The Pageant of Jerusalem," joint editor, "Handbook of Palestine, 1922"; edr., "Gen. Regs. of the Govt. of Palestine."

KELLAGHER, GEORGE BANNERMAN.—B. 1889; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1919; cadet, S.S., 1913; attd. res. councillor's office, Penang, Dec., 1913; attd. G.P.O., Singapore, May, 1914; passed cadet, Feb., 1917; supernmy. offr., cls. V., Feb., 1917; on mil. serv., Apr., 1917; 2nd lieut., R.E., Dec., 1917; B.E.F., France, Apr., 1918; wounded Oct., 1918; lieut., June, 1919; demob., Feb., 1920; supernmy. offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1920; offr., cls. III., 1925; currency comntr., Mar., 1927; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1930; European agency, Kedah, Mar., 1933.

KELLIE, GEORGE GORDON.—Seconded from London postal serv. and apptd. 2nd asst. dir., posts and tels., Somaliland, Jan., 1924; postal asst. dir., Somaliland, Apr., 1926; ag. D.P.T., June-Oct., 1927; survr., posts and tels., Tanganyika Territory, 1931.

KELLY, SIR HENRY GREENE, KT. BACH. (1906).—Ed. Trin. Coll., Dub.; honorman and prizeman in hist. and political science; B.A. and LL.B.; called to the bar, King's Inn, Dub., Mich. Term, 1894; apptd. a puisne judge in the Niger Territories, 1891; acted on several occasions as chief justice; chief justice, 1899; chief justice of Southern Nigeria, 1900; ret., 10th Feb., 1908.

KELLY, HON. HUGH THOMAS.—B. 1858; ed. St. Michael's Coll., Toronto, and Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, 1886; K.C., 1908; pres., York Co. Law Assoc., 1910 and 1911; chmn., Toronto pub. lib. bd. for 3 years; a gov. of Toronto Univ., 1906-1912; jud. of high ct. of Ontario, 1911.

KELLY, ROBERT ALSOFT, A.S.A.A., J.P.—B. 1881; ed. George Heriot's Schl., Edinburgh; clk., inland rev., 1898; S.A. war, 1900-02 (Queen's med., 5 clasps); asst. acct., N. Rhodesia, 1911; assist. audr., 1913; ag. audr., 1914-15 and in 1919; lieut., N.R. Rifles, 1916; ag. adjt., 1917-18; dep. treas., N. Rhodesia, 1921; ag. treas., 1922; ag. treas. and mem., exec. coun., 1925, 1927 and 1928; ag. comntr., taxes, 1928; treas. and currency offr., mem., exec. and leg. couns., Gold Coast, 1929.

KELLY, ROBERT WILLIAM CREIGHTON, M.R.C.S.(Eng.), L.R.C.P.(Lond.)—B. 1888; med. offr. i/c schls. and venereal diseases, S.S., Apr., 1923; med. offr., social hygiene, May, 1926; health offr., May, 1927; chief med. offr., social hygiene, S.S. Feb., 1928.

KELSICK, OSCAR RICHARDSON.—Ag. cashier, savings bank, Antigua, Aug., 1906; apptd. as ditto, Jan., 1908; acctnt., savings bank, Sept., 1908; treas., May to Aug., 1909; junr. audit
KENNIFIE, VICTOR, B.E. (SYD.), A.M.I.C.E., A.M.I.E. (AUST.), M.I.M. AND C.T. R.—B.1856; ed. Sydney High Schl. and Sydney Univ.; nat. eng., P.W.D., N. S. Wales, 1916; dist. eng., P.W.D., Fiji, 1921; ag. amt. commr. of whs., 1927; ag. commr. of wks., chmn., cent. road bd., Apl. to Dec., 1927; mem., leg. coun., Fiji, Nov. to Dec., 1927; asst. D.P.W., Cyprus, Mar., 1936; ag. D.P.W. on various occasions, 1930-33.

KENT, HENRY TUFFIELD MONEY, A.C.G.I., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1886; ed. Elstow schl. Cit. and Guilds Coll.; instr., tech. schl., F.M.S., Sex., 1914; ag. timber suptd., F.M.S., rly., Dec., 1914; contr., timber supplies, F.M.S., rly., Jan., 1919; ditto, forest dept., S. Stltmtn. and F.M.S., Jan., 1923; sent to report on timber utilization problems in India and Burma, May, 1924; on spl. duty, Madison, U.S.A., Nov. to Dec., 1925; prin., tech. schl., F.M.S., Dec., 1930.

KENT, HON. JAS. M.—K.C., R.A.; M.H.A., Newfoundland, 1904; mem. of exec. com. and min. of just., 1907; judge, supreme ct., 1914.

KERR, DAVID IRVINE—B. 1878; clk. to pol. mag., Grenada, 1899; rev. offr. (various grades), 1902-15; 2nd clk., treas., 1918; ch. rev. offr., 1919; ag. ch. of pol., 1920 and 1924; ch. cl. P.W.D., 1921; sup't., of prisons and recorder's meteorological obsns., 1922; seconded for war service (Egypt and E. Africa), 1915-19; J.P., 1919.

KERR, ROBERT ASHFORD—B. 1870; ed. p.m. sch., Swellendam; served Matabele war as rebellion and seriously wounded in latter; force mem., dep. ch., and ch. of com. prov. coun., Transvaal and pres. senate; mem., Union senate 1921.

KERR, ROBERT TAYLOR, A.M.I.Mech.I., M.I., Loco.E.—B. 1888; ed. Dumfries Acad., British Rly., 1905; wks. man., Gold Coast, Apr., 1915; title changed to asst. loco. eng., Jan., 1917; seconded to Togoland mly. for 18 periods, 1917-20; dist. loco. supt., Gold Coast, Apr., 1923; wks. man., July, 1925; ch. mech. engrn., Apr., 1926.

KERR-PEARSE, MAJOR B.A.T., C.M.G., (formerly Rifle Brigade).—B. 1871; A.D.C. to gen. of Australia (Lord Northcote), 1903-07; priv. sec. to gov. of West Australia (Sir G. Strickland), 1904-12; priv. sec. to gov. of Tasmania (Rt. Hon. Sir W. Ellison-Macartney), 1913-15; priv. sec. to gov.-gen. of Australia (Rt. Hon. Sir R. Munro Ferguson), 1915-16; mil. sec., 1916.

KERSHAW, ARTHUR EDWIN POMEROL, M.C., A.I.M.M.—B. 1890; inspr., mines, F.M.S., 1912; sec. for mly. serv., Sept., 1917; 2nd loc. R.F.A. (S.R.), Feb., 1918; demob., Feb., 1919; inspr., mines, F.M.S., 1919; asst. warden, mines, Sept., 1921; senr. inspr., mines, B. Gajah, Feb., 1931; asst. warden, mines, Perak, Apr., 1931.

KEY, WALTER JOHN SMITH, A.M.I.C.E., A.M.I.Struct.E.—B. 1896; ed. Dundee Tech. Schl., Dundee Tech. Coll. and St. Andrews Univ.; asst. engrn., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1923.

KIBBLE, EDMUND DAVID, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1881; ed. Highgate Schl. and City & Guilds (Engnr.) Coll., S. Kensington; asst. engr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Dec., 1907; ex. engr., P.W.D., F.M.S., 1914; senr. ex. engr., 1915; att'd, govt. town planning dept., F.M.S., Aug., 1924; state engrn., Pahang, June, 1927; hyd. engnr., Aug., 1930; state engrn., Pahang, Jan., 1932.

KIDD, MAJOR GEORGE MONTGOMERY, R.A., Dublin, M.C.—B. 1889; cadet, F.M.S., 1912; seconded for mly. serv. 1915 to 1919;
to advr., Kedah, Jan., 1920; ast. agt., food contr., S. Kedah, Feb., 1920; agt., food contr., Kedah, Sept., 1920; dep. supt., census, Kedah, Oct., 1920; sec., sany. bd., Alor Star, Sept., 1922; sec., rubber restn. comte., Kedah, Oct., 1922; attd., rubber restn. off., K. Lumpur, Feb., 1925; chmn., assess. comte., F.M.S., Mar., 1925; dist. offr., May, 1927; offr., cls. II, Dec., 1929; chmn., sany. bd., Kinta, Dec., 1929; ag. ast. advr., Muar, Sept., 1932.

KIDD, CAPT. W. R., M.C., B.A. (Oxon).—Aast. dist. comsnr., Kenya, Feb., 1920.

KIDGER, CECIL EDWARD.—B. 1875; ed. Cranbrook Pub. Sch.; ent. Cape civ. serv., 1894; Cape Garrison Art.; S.A. War, 1899-1902; ast. mag., Queenstown, Middledrift, Capetown, 1908; ditto, Taung v. Rhynsdorp, Bredasdorp, Pilgrims Rest, Witbank, Pietersburg, 1915-32; ditto, Bloemfontein, 1932.

KIDSON, ERNEST, O.B.E. (1919), M.A., D.Sc., F.Inst.P.—B. 1882; ed. Nelson Coll. and Canterbury Coll., N.Z.; on staff, Australian Commonwealth meteorological bureau, 1921-27; ast. dir., 1923-27; dir., meteorological services, N.Z., 1927.

KIDSON, NORMAN S. B.—B. 1885; served in Connaught Rangers, 1914-19; 2nd ast. mast., Boys' Gram. Schl., Fiji, Mar., 1920; clk. of peace, Rewa, Sept., 1920; ag. dist. comsnr., Rewa and ag. prov. comsnr., Naitasiri, Mar., 1921; ag. dist. comsnr. and prov. comsnr., Colo East, Apr., 1921; govt. sec., Br. Solomon Is., Prot., Nov., 1922; on sp. duty as judl. comsnr. for W. Pacific, Apr., 1924; has acted as offr.-in-charge at headqrs. on several occasions; ag.-res. comsnr. on various occasions, 1925-1932; offl. mem., advisory coun., 1927; judl. comsnr. (temp. and provisional), Nov., 1928.

KILPIN, RALPH.—B. 1887; ed. Diocesan Coll., Rondebosch, S. Africa; clk. of papers, Cape H. of A., 1905; clk. of papers, Union H. of A., 1910; 2nd clk.-ast., 1917; clk.-ast. and acctnt., 1920; admitted sworn translator (Eng. and Dutch), sup. ct., of S. Africa, 1912; assessor apptd. by admstr., Cape exec. comte., elections and elec. of senators since 1910; on active serv., E. Africa, 1916-17; recd. vote of thanks of leg. assembly, S.W. Africa, for preparing standing rules and orders and assisting in inauguration of assembly, 1926; author of "The Old Cape House" and "The Romance of a Colonial Parliament."

KIMBELL, ALFRED HENRY.—B. 1875; ed. at Otago Boys' High Schl., N.Z.; entd. N.Z. pub. serv., 1895; held various positions in P.W.D., includg. land purch. offr.; und.-sec. of mines, 1920.

KIMBER, GURTH.—B. 1906; ed. Perse Schl. and Cambridge; nat. sci. schl., Clare Coll., 1924-27; 1st cls. nat. sci. tripos, pt. I, 1926; 2nd cls., pt. II, 1927; B.A., 1927; apptd. after compet. exam., ast. prin., Dominions Office, 19th Oct., 1928; temp. agt. prin., 18th Mar., 1932.

KING, CLEMENT HAMPDEN.—B. 1876; ed. Queen's Coll., B. Guiana; ag. 5th cls. clk., police dept., B. Guiana, June, 1938; gradual prom. to prin. clk.; dist. inspr. of police, 1901; county inspr., Dec., 1908; ag. adjt., July, 1907 to Mar., 1908, Sept., 1908 to Feb., 1909, and from Oct., 1911 to Apr., 1912; adjt. and staff offr., local forces, Oct., 1914 to Aug., 1919; capt., B. Guiana Militia, Oct., 1914; major, Aug., 1919; ag. deputy inspr.-gen. and supt. of Georgetown fire brig., July to Oct., 1914; ag. deputy inspr.-gen. on various occasions; dep. inspr.-gen. pol. and supt. fire brigade, Aug., 1919; comsnr. pol., Sierra Leone, June, 1921.

KING, SIR FREDERICK TRUBY, Kt. Bach. (1925), C.M.G. (1917), M.B., B.Sc.—Founder of New Zealand Plunket Soc'y, and famous for his work in connection with infant-life protection; dir. of divn. of child-welfare, N.Z. health dept., 1921; inspr.-gen., mental hosps., 1926-27.

KING, GEORGE HOWARD, I.S.O. (1932).—Ag. clk., treas., St. Kitts, 1894; ag. rev. offr., Nevis, 1895; clk., P.O., St. Kitts, 1896; ag. clk., regir.'s office, Nevis, 1897; rev. offr., Nevis, Jan., 1898; govt. offr., St. Kitts, 1899; rev. offr., Nevis, June, 1905; 1st clk., P.O., and sub-inspr. of schls., St. Kitts, 1906; ag. postmtr., St. Kitts, 1914; postmtr., May, 1915.

KING, JOHN EDMUND.—B. 1900; entered C.O., Sept., 1916; served with R.N.V.R. from 30th Sept. to 19th Dec., 1918; apptd. after compet. exam., ast. clk., C.O., Apr., 1918; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; higher grade cler. offr., 4th July, 1928.

KING, JOHN GEORGE MAYDON.—B. 1908; ed. Oundle Schl. and S. Eastern Agril. Coll., Wye, Kent; dipl. agr.; C.O. Agril. schol., Cambridge, 1929-30; dist. agr. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1931.

KING, LOUIS HERBERT, M.I.E.E.—B. 1880; chf. engrnr. and mannr., elec. wks., Dar-es-Salaam, 1919; chf. elec. engrnr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1923.

KING, PERCY WILLIAM.—B. 1891; ed. Seminary, Quebec and Mungret Coll., Ireland; passed final exam., Law Soc.; ag. offr., recur., pub. trustee and crown solr., Br. Guiana, in 1920, 1921 and 1922; offr. recur., pub. trustee and crown solr., 1923; ag. ast. col. sec. in 1932.

KING, SYDNEY NOEL.—B. 1897; ed. Dover Coll. and Bedford Schl.; served in R.F.A., 1916-1920 (coman., Aug., 1916); cadet, S.S., Mar., 1920; passed cadet, Mar., 1922; offr., cls. V., Mar., 1923; offr., cls. IV., Mar., 1927; ast. advr., Kukub, July, 1928; ag. 1st mag., Johore Bahru, Sept., 1928; dep. pres., town bd., in addn., Oct., 1928; dep. pub. pros., Johore, Nov., 1929; offr., cls. III., Mar., 1932; 2nd astt. sec. (A) S.S., Aug., 1933.

KING, STUART EDGAR.—B. 1898; ed. Merchant Taylor's Schl. and St. John's Coll., Oxford; cadet, S.S., July, 1921; astd. Chinese prot., S'pore, Aug., 1921; offr., cls. V., July, 1924; astt. prot., Chinese and astt. contribr., lab., S'pore, Apr., 1926; offr., cls. IV., astt. prot., Chinese, Perak, July, 1928; ditto, Malacca, Apr., 1931; offr., cls. III., July, 1933; ag. prot., Chinese, Perak, Sept., 1933.

KING, THOMAS HENRY.—B. 1883; ed. at Exeter Gram. Schl.; pol. probationer, Hong Kong, 1904; passed in Cantonese, 1907; attched. to Punjab pol., 1907; passed in Hindustani, 1907; ag. astt. supt. of pol., 1908; J.P., 1908; ag.-supt., impts. and expts., Dec., 1909; astt. emigrn. offr. in addition to pol. duties, 1910; passed in Punjabi, 1910; ag. astt.-supt., pol., 1911; mem., bd. of exams., 1912; astt. supt., pol., 1912; ag. dep. supt., pol. and fire brig., 1913; dep. supt., pol., 1921; ag. capt. supt., pol., 1921 and June-July, 1925; dir., crim. intellig., 1923; ag. capt. supt., pol., Mar. to Nov., 1929; dep. inspr.-gen., pol., Sept., 1930; ag. inspr.-gen., pol., Mar.-Oct., 1932.

KING, WILLIAM CYRIL CAMPBELL.—B. 1891; ed. Cranbrook schl.; probr., Ceylon pol., 1912; astt. supt., pol., 1914; on active serv., 1917-19; supt., pol., 1921; ag. dep. inspr.-gen., pol., 1931-32; ch. commndt., pol. and inspr., prisons, Cyprus, Aug., 1933.

KING, Rt. Hon. WILLIAM LYON MACKENZIE, P.C. (1922), C.M.G. (1906), M.A., Toronto Univ., LL.B., Toronto Univ., Ph.D., Harvard
Univ.—B. 1874; apptd. dep. min. of labour and editor of "Labour Gazette," 1902; regisr. of boards of conciliation and investigation, 1907; sworn of the Privy Council for Canada and min. of labour, 1909; defeated at g.e., 1911; special investigator, Rockefeller Foundation, 1914; chosen leader of the opposition, H. of C., Aug., 1919; elec. by acclamation for Prince Co., P.E.I., 20th Oct., 1919; re-elec. for N. York, Ont., g.e., Dec., 1921; prime minister, Dominion of Canada, 29th Dec., 1921, also pres. of the coun. and sec. of state for external affairs; represented Canada at Imp. Confce., 1923; prime min., 1926-30; leader of opposition, 1930.

KINGDON, SIR DONALD, Kt. Bach. (1931), K.C., M.A., LL.B.—Ed. at Eastbourne Coll. and St. John's Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, In. Tem., July, 1905; legal ass't. and inspr. of schls., Gambia, Jan., 1907; mem. of exec. and legis. couns.; as col. sec., Mar. to July, 1912; atty.-gen., Uganda, Oct., 1912; ag. chief just., Apr., 1917, to July, 1918; atty.-gen., G. Coast, Sept., 1918; mem. of exec. and legis. couns.; ag. col. sec., Apr. to Oct., 1919; compiler of 1920 revd. edn., G. Coast laws, 1920; atty. gen., Nigeria, Apr., 1921; mem., exec. and legis. couns.; compiler, revd. edn., Nigeria laws, 1923; ag. ch. sec. to govt., Oct., 1928 to Feb., 1929; ch. just., Sept., 1929.

KING-HARMAN, SIR CHARLES ANTHONY, K.C.M.G. (1900), C.M.G. (1893).—B. 1851; ed. Chelt. Coll.; B.A. of Trin. Coll., Camb., 1872; M.A. 1879; priv. sec. to the gov. of the Bahamas, Nov., 1874, to Nov., 1879; priv. sec. to high comsnr., Cyprus, Dec., 1879; asst. comsnr., Cyprus, Dec., 1879; asst. to the ch. sec., Cyprus, Mar., 1881; ag. ch. sec. and mem. of exec. and legis. couns., June to Sept., 1882; auditor-gen., Barbados, 1883; elected mem. of house of assem., 1884-93; ag. col. sec. and mem. of exec. coun., 1884, 1885, and 1886; col. sec., Mauritius, 1893; ag. gov., Jan. to Aug., 1894, and Mar. to Sept., 1896; adminstr., St. Lucia, 1897; gov. S. Leone, Oct., 1900; high comsnr., Cyprus, 15th Apr., 1904; represented Mediterranean Colonies at the Coronation of H.M. King George V., 1911.

KINGHORN, ALLAN.—B. 1879; ed. Toronto Grammar Schl., W. Toronto Collegiate Inst. and Univ. of Toronto, M.B. hons., 1904; M.C.P. & S., Ont., 1905; M.D., Toronto, 1929; trypanosomiasis investig., N. Rhodesia, 1907-09; apl. serv. med. offr., Gold Coast, 1909-11; in ch., Luangwa sleeping sickness comsnr., N. Rhodesia, 1911-12; med. offr., N. Rhodesia, 1912; war serv., 1914-17 (ment. in desp.); seconded, plague investig., Nyasaland, 1917; anti-plague measures, Luangwa valley, N. Rhodesia, 1917; senr. med. offr., 1931; dep. dir., med. services, 1932; dir., med. services, 1933; publications, "Bionomics Glomina Morsitans, 1911"; "Report of Luangwa S.S. Commission (collected papers), 1912"; "Human Trypanosomiasis in Luangwa Valley," 1925.

KINGSBURY, ALLAN NEAVE, B.Sc. (Eng.), M.B., B.S. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P., D.P.H., D.T.M. & H. (Lond.).—Asst. pathologist, Middlesex Hosp. and bacteriologist, Middlesex Hosp., ven. diseases clinic; pathologist, City of Lond. Mat. Hosp.; lieut., R.F.A.; ag. govt. pathologist, Penang, 1923; pathologist, Inst. for Med. Research, F.M.S., 1924; on sp. duty in India and Ceylon, 1924; ag. bacteriologist, Inst. for Med. Research and ag. dir., govt. laboratories, F.M.S., 1925; professor of bacteriology, King Ed. VII. Coll. of Medicine, Singapore, 1926; bacteriologist, Inst. Med. Research, F.M.S., Apr., 1927; ag. dir., ditto, Aug., 1927; dir., ditto, Oct., 1927; awarded N. Persian Forces memorial med. for research, Oct., 1927; del. L. of N. health organization laboratory confce., Copenhagen, May 1928; rep. C.O. at Internat. Cancer Confce., London, July, 1928; rep. F.M.S. at Leonard Wood memorial leprosy confce., Manila, Dec., 1930; author of many medical and scientific publications.

KINLOCH, JOHN BAXTER.—B. 1906; ed. Kirkcaldy High Schl. and Edin. and Oxford Univs.; B.Sc., forestry, Edin., 1927; asst. conservator, forests, Br. Honduras, Oct., 1927.

KINNEAR, GEORGE, M.D. (Univ. of Manitoba), M.C.P.S. (Sask.), Certif. L.S.T.M. and H.—B.1894; ed. Regina Collegiate Inst., 1st certif., Regina Normal Schol., 1912; priv. Ear Grey and Govan. Pub. Schls. (Sask.), 1912-17; Leeward Is. med. serv., 1926; D.M.O., dist. B., Dominica; M.O., Bahamas gen. hosp., 1929; M.O. and bacteriologist, Bahamas gen. hosp., 1931; ag. ch. med. offr., 1932.

KIPPING, RUPERT HARRY, M.B., Ch.B. (Leeds).—B. 1904; late jun. house surg., Dartington Genl. Hosp.; locum house surg., Shepshed Roy. Hosp.; med. offr., Somaliland, Feb., 1929.

KIRBY, A. C.—Asst. dist. comsnr., F.A.P., Dec., 1913; 2nd grade res., Nyasaland, Jan., 1925; 1st grade res., Mar., 1927; ag. p.r. comsnr., June, 1933.

KIRK, JAMES BALFOUR.—B. 1893; ed. George Watson's Coll., Edinburgh and Edin. Univ., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), M.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.P.H. (Oxford), D.T.M. & H. (Eng.), F.Z.S. (Lond. and Scot.), Vans Dunlop scholarship bot. sci., Edin. Univ., 1911, certif. (with distinc.) L.S.T.M., 1922; 2nd lieut., R.F.A., 1914-16; lieut., R.A.M.C. (S.R.), 1917; capt., 1918; med. offr., Jul., 1918-19; civ. surg., Arabia, 1919; asst. M.O., Baghdad, 1919-20; bacteriologist, R. Inst. Pub. Health, 1920-21; demobilized, L.S.T.M., 1921; M.O.H., Mauritius, 1922; med. and health dept., 1927; author of "Public Health Practice in the Tropics" (1931), "Health on Equipment and Health for intending residents in the Tropics," and several articles on med. and hygienic subjects.

KIRKHAM, G. H.—B. 1881; S. Afr. Army constab., 1901; served S. African War, 1899-1902 (wounded); Transvaal pol., 1908; adjt., 4th S. African Mounted Riflemen, 1914; S. African Rebellion, 1914; capt., 1st S. African Inf. (Overseas Brig.) 1916-18; German W. Africa campaign, 1914-16; ment. in desp., Frere, 1916-17 (twice wounded); M.C., Apr., 1917; King's pol. med.; dep. comsnr., pol. med., Tanganyika Territory, 1918; comsnr., 1919.

KIRKPATRICK, THOMAS WINIFRED, M.A. (Cantab.), Dipl. Agr. (Cantab.), F.E.S.—B. 1876; ed. Marlborough and Gonville and Caius Coll., Cambridge; mil. serv., 1915-19; entomologist, min. of agr., Egypt, 1921; do., Kenya Col., 1925; entomologist, Welcome Trop. Resear. Labs., Sudan, 1928; entomologist, E. Amani agr. research stn., Amani, Tanganyika Territory, 1931.
